scripts.text: Have you heard of the mercenary revolt in Schwaltzvalt?
scripts.translation: 你听说过施瓦茨瓦尔特的佣兵叛乱吗？

scripts.text: To tell you briefly, the mercenaries were used as a garrison of the republic. But as the republic developed a Guardian, they were about to be abandoned. Then the mercenaries rose in revolt and were nearly annihilated.
scripts.translation: 简单来说，佣兵曾担任共和国的守备部队。后来共和国开发出守护者，佣兵眼看就要被抛弃，于是发动叛乱，最后几乎全军覆没。

scripts.text: Some of the remnants went to Figel, But the rest of them gathered in Einbech and Einbroch to organize the Rebellion. By the way, Einbroch is a large city where many people live ans pass by. Isn't it?
scripts.translation: 一部分残党逃到了菲格尔，其余的人则聚集在艾音贝赫和艾音布罗克，成立了反叛者组织。艾音布罗克人来人往，是座大城市，对吧？

scripts.text: So the Rebellion put their guild in Einbroch. The rest of them were hiding somewhere else in Einbroch. That's why I suggested you to meet in Einbech..
scripts.translation: 反叛者把公会设在艾音布罗克，其他成员则藏身在艾音布罗克的其他地方。这就是我提议在艾音贝赫见面的原因。

scripts.text: Anyway, the government was overlooking the remnants for various reasons. I'm sure the government is still uncomfortable about it.
scripts.translation: 总之，政府出于各种原因一直对这些残党睁一只眼闭一只眼。我敢说，政府现在还是觉得很棘手。

scripts.text: That's why this negotiation is so important. We are going to asking for help to the guy who's angry at me. It won't be easy.
scripts.translation: 所以这次谈判才这么重要。我们要向一个恨我的家伙求助，肯定不会轻松。

scripts.text: We should them a sense of apology and a promise of hope in the future. At the same time, ^0000cdwe have to relax their mind and promise with them to cooperate in future affairs^000000...
scripts.translation: 我们得表达歉意，也要让他们看到未来的希望。同时，安抚他们，并承诺今后会与他们合作... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Just by listening to it, it sounds really difficult.
scripts.translation: 光听你说就觉得很难办。

scripts.text: The most difficult thing is how to enter the ^0000cdsecret base^000000 rather than talking to them.
scripts.translation: 比起怎么跟他们谈，真正难的是怎么进入秘密基地。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Anyway, we will think about the method on our way there. You Just trust me and follow me. Nothing is impossible as long as you trust me. You can trust me in any situation.
scripts.translation: 路上再想办法吧。你只要相信我，跟着我就行。只要信任我，没有什么办不到。无论什么时候都可以相信我。

scripts.text: I don't have much faith in you.
It's okay, because I trust myself. Out of all these people in this large world, I am the only one whom I trust. So you just follow me.
scripts.translation: 没关系，我信我自己。这世上这么多人，我只相信自己。你跟着我就行。

scripts.text: You have great faith in yourself.
Of course. If I don't feel confident about myself, I can't do this job.
scripts.translation: 当然。对自己没信心，怎么做这份工作？

scripts.text: Sometimes I have to face some unpleasant situation, and do things that are not sometimes moral. But for my task and survival, I must not hesitate to make momentary decisions and execute my actions.
scripts.translation: 有时我得面对糟心的处境，甚至做些不太道德的事。但为了任务和生存，我必须果断决策，立刻行动。

scripts.text: And let's say you begin to doubt it. Once your mind starts to shake, the task will be in danger. Unwavering confidence is more important than anything else.
scripts.translation: 要是你开始怀疑自己，心一动摇，任务就会陷入险境。坚定的信念比什么都重要。

scripts.text: Of course, you need the capability to support your confidence. You can't trust anything without evidence.
scripts.translation: 当然，自信也得有本事支撑。没有依据，什么都不能轻信。

scripts.text: After listening to what you said, I don't fully trust you. But I feel like having to trust you.
scripts.translation: 听你这么一说，我虽然还没完全信任你，但感觉也只能信你了。

scripts.text: It's quite natural. Very good. Good luck in our mission. My goal is to build a reputation of a fantastic duo with you.
scripts.translation: 这很正常。很好，祝我们任务顺利。我希望咱俩能成为一对名声响亮的搭档。

scripts.text: The ticket gate is over there! We have to pay for the train. Are you saying we will walk there?
scripts.translation: 检票口在那边！坐火车得买票。你是想走过去吗？

scripts.text: Yikes! Pipe down!! Of course we are taking a train. In a special place and in a special way.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，小声点！！我们当然坐火车，只不过要用特别的方法，从特别的地方上车。

scripts.text: If you want to call it a free ride, go ahead. But do you really want to discount your action as a 'free ride'? You can used the elegant expression 'occupation after closed infiltration'.
scripts.translation: 你要叫逃票也行。不过，你真想把自己的行动说成“逃票”吗？可以说得体面一点，叫作“秘密潜入后的占领行动”。

scripts.text: Usually, we can feel buy tickets, say hello to the station staff eat delicious snacks, and enjoy our trip.
scripts.translation: 平常我们可以买票、和车站工作人员打招呼、买点好吃的零食，悠闲地享受旅程。

scripts.text: But we are in the middle of a mission. It's already begun. It's kind of an emergency. So we have to be tense.
scripts.translation: 但我们正在执行任务，行动已经开始了，情况紧急，当然得绷紧神经。

scripts.text: I really don't understand the relationship between being tense and free riding.
scripts.translation: 我还是不明白，绷紧神经和逃票有什么关系。

scripts.text: Do you really thing I'm just trying to save 200 Zeny? I know what I'm doing. You just follow me without nagging. We are in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 你真以为我只是想省200 Zeny？我自有打算。别再唠叨了，跟上我，我们赶时间。

scripts.text: Why aren't you following me? We might miss the train!
scripts.translation: 你怎么还不跟上？要赶不上火车了！

scripts.text: Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation: 好久不见！我要去另一个任务地点了，知道了吗？回头见！

scripts.text: Are you okay to be here now?
scripts.translation: 你现在在这里没问题吧？

scripts.text: Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation: 好久不见！我要去另一个任务地点了，知道了吗？回头见！

scripts.text: It is a small hole where one person can barely pass through.
scripts.translation: 这是个小洞，只勉强容得下一个人通过。

scripts.text: You passed through the hole where one person can barely enter.
scripts.translation: 你从那个仅容一人勉强通过的小洞里钻了过去。

scripts.text: We are going to take a train here. Do you see ^0000cdvery small hole^000000 in the sewer down there?
scripts.translation: 我们要从这里搭火车。看到下面下水道里的那个小洞了吗？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Is this... a ^0000cddoghole^000000? I heard the Secret Wings is an executive office of the President. Why are you so needy?
scripts.translation: 这...是个狗洞吗？我听说秘密之翼是总统的行政机关。你们怎么这么寒酸？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Shh--- I told you not to mention that name. Be careful from now on. I don't want to be stabbed on my back for something I didn't do. If you really want to say it, call it Heron.
scripts.translation: 嘘---我不是说过别提那个名字吗？之后小心点。我可不想因为没做过的事被人在背后捅刀。真要提的话，就叫它“白鹭”。

scripts.text: I mean, why do you have to go through a place like this? Don't they pay you any activity cost? Maybe his excellency doesn't care for all your comfort.
scripts.translation: 我是说，你为什么非得从这种地方走？他们不给你发行动经费吗？也许总统根本不在乎你过得舒不舒服。

scripts.text: It's not true. We receive a free pass to use all means of transportation in this continent. They includes airship, train and teleporting, etc.
scripts.translation: 不是这样的。我们拥有使用本大陆所有交通工具的免费通行证。包括飞空艇、火车和传送等。

scripts.text: Then why do you have to go through a place like this?
scripts.translation: 那你们为什么非要走这种地方？

scripts.text: Because we don't want to leave the records. We must not be detected by others. Although we get captured, our moving route must be hidden. The moving routes can be a great clue.
scripts.translation: 因为我们不想留下记录。我们必须不被他人发现。即使我们被抓住了，我们的移动路线也必须隐藏。移动路线可能会成为重要的线索。

scripts.text: No wonder we have the word 'secret' in our name. That's why I move so carefully during my mission.
scripts.translation: 难怪我们的名字里有“秘密”这个词。这就是为什么我在执行任务时如此小心。

scripts.text: To avoid being detected, duck yourself and follow me.
scripts.translation: 为了不被发现，请低下头，跟着我。

scripts.text: Yuno~ Visit Yuno~ If you were born as a human, go to Yuno~ If you have come to Schwaltzvalt, go to Yuno~ If you are breathing, go to Yuno~
scripts.translation: 朱诺~ 去见朱诺~ 如果你生而为人，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你来到了施瓦茨瓦尔特，就去朱诺那里~ 如果你还在呼吸，就去朱诺那里~

scripts.text: He told me he'd come here. Maybe he's still in Einbroch train station? I have to go there again.
scripts.translation: 他告诉我他会来这里。也许他还在艾音布罗克火车站？我得再去一趟。

scripts.text: This is Einbech. The last time I came here, I was being chased by 17 pursuers.
scripts.translation: 这里是艾音贝赫。上次我来这里的时候，被17个追捕者追着跑。

scripts.text: I'm sorry I can't tell more than that. It's confidential.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不能透露更多。这是机密。

scripts.text: Hey! I just cracked a joke before starting on the mission. You can't even accept?
scripts.translation: 嘿！任务开始前开个玩笑而已，你连这个都受不了吗？

scripts.text: I'm a little nervous. A negotiation...
scripts.translation: 我有点紧张。毕竟是要去谈判...

scripts.text: You don't have to be nervous. I'm going to be in charge of talking to them. You just add several words beside me.
scripts.translation: 不用紧张，谈判由我负责。你只要在旁边附和几句就好。

scripts.text: In this mission, the trust is important. There is a reason why the government assigned you to this mission in addition to me, a professional negotiator.
scripts.translation: 这次任务的关键是信任。政府除了派我这位专业谈判人员，也派了你来，自有原因。

scripts.text: You are known as a hero in this Midgard continent and a symbol of trust. If you come with me, the Rebellion will be less stubborn to us. Once we get trusted by them, everything will work out.
scripts.translation: 你在米德加尔特大陆上是公认的英雄，也是信任的象征。有你同行，反叛者对我们的戒心就会少一些。只要取得他们的信任，一切都会顺利。

scripts.text: Talking like that in that clothes, you don't look very persuasive.
scripts.translation: 穿成这样说这种话，实在没什么说服力。

scripts.text: This is my critical costume I prepared for this mission. Who would ever find a tourist suspicious?
scripts.translation: 这是我为这次任务准备的特别装扮。谁会怀疑一个游客呢？

scripts.text: As I mentioned before, our greatest challenge is to enter the Rebellion's secret base without any armed conflict. This costume is for that purpose.
scripts.translation: 正如我之前说的，最大的难题是不引发冲突，进入反叛者的秘密基地。这身装扮就是为此准备的。

scripts.text: And Yuno is such a nice place. I have a dream to buy a building there after retirement and spend my golden years comfortably.
scripts.translation: 而且朱诺是个好地方。我梦想退休后在那里买栋房子，舒舒服服地安度晚年。

scripts.text: Don't they normally choose a resort like Comodo for golden years?
scripts.translation: 通常人们不是会选克魔岛这样的度假胜地安度晚年吗？

scripts.text: Oh, I don't like a beach. I saw the sea every single day when I was young. Now I'm sick of its salty smell. To leave the sea, I used to have a dream to become a captain of airship.
scripts.translation: 哦，我不喜欢海滩。小时候天天见海，现在闻到咸咸的海风都腻了。为了离开大海，我以前还梦想过当飞空艇船长呢。

scripts.text: If you wanted to become a pilot, why did you become a secret agent?
scripts.translation: 既然你想当飞空艇驾驶员，怎么后来成了特工？

scripts.text: I can't tell you. It's confidential.
Oh, when you get back after the mission, you can purchase a train ticket and show it to the employee in the train station. But it's free for me.
scripts.translation: 任务结束后回来时，记得买张火车票给站务员看。不过我坐车不用买票。

scripts.text: Well, where should we go now?
scripts.translation: 那么，我们现在该去哪里？

scripts.text: We have go somewhere deep inside the village. From here on, just trust me and follow me. Since the path is a little complicated, I will leave ^0000cdtraces^000000. Make sure you catch them up.
scripts.translation: 我们得去村子深处。从这里开始，你只管相信我，跟着我走。路有点复杂，我会留下记号，记得跟上。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What are you doing? I told you to follow me.
scripts.translation: 你在干什么？我让你跟着我。

scripts.text: We are not supposed to be here now.
We must go to the rebellion.
Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation: 好久不见！我要去另一个任务地点了。明白了吗？回头见！

scripts.text: Wait. Stop right there. Somebody is lying down here. Don't step on it. Hey, watch out!
scripts.translation: 等等，先停下。这里有人躺着，别踩到他！小心！

scripts.text: If I get rid of this and that...!
scripts.translation: 要是把这个和那个都处理掉...！

scripts.text: Wow... I think today is a lucky day. This mission is going to be easier than we thought.
scripts.translation: 哇...看来今天运气真好。这次任务会比想象中轻松。

scripts.text: What's written on the bottom? Dying message? Are they words? How come he never practiced writing even if he was a Gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 底下写了什么？遗言吗？这是字吗？他明明是个枪手，怎么连字都没练好？

scripts.text: Adventurer, try to heal this man. Although he has an injury, it's not so serious. Since he's collapsed due to an exhaustion, he'll probably recover himself by a simple treatment. Once he wakes up, I will take all the information from him.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，试着给这个人治疗一下。他伤得不重，只是累倒了，简单处理一下应该就能恢复。等他醒来，我就问他要情报。

scripts.text: I don't know how to heal.
Well, I have no other choice.
Odin, Freyja, Thor and a god of exhausted traveler. Please show us a mercy!
scripts.translation: 奥丁、芙蕾雅、托尔，还有疲惫旅人的守护神啊，请赐予我们慈悲吧！

scripts.text: Wow... You're a secret agent and you also know how to heal?
scripts.translation: 哇...你是特工，居然还会治疗？

scripts.text: Oh, after experiencing so many things, you should do it all.
scripts.translation: 经历了这么多事情，当然得样样都会啊。

scripts.text: I'am so good at various arts and craft. I am such a great person.
scripts.translation: 我精通各种技艺，真是个了不起的人。

scripts.text: He won't wake up immediately, but he'll save his life anyway. If we were too late, he would have died.
scripts.translation: 他不会马上醒来，不过至少保住性命了。要是再晚一点，他恐怕就没命了。

scripts.text: What are you doing? Carry him.
scripts.translation: 你还愣着干什么？把他背起来。

scripts.text: Are we carrying him? I thought we were on a secret mission.
scripts.translation: 要背着他走？我还以为我们在执行秘密任务呢。

scripts.text: We ^0000cdmust bring^000000 him. No matter what happens, we must bring this man. He will be our ticket to the base.
scripts.translation: 我们必须带上他。无论如何都得把他带走，他会是我们进入基地的通行证。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Good question. But since we don't have enough time, let me explain later. We must deliver him before he dies.
scripts.translation: 问得好。不过时间紧迫，我之后再解释。得赶在他断气前把他送出去。

scripts.text: What are you doing? I told you to follow me.
scripts.translation: 你在干什么？我让你跟着我。

scripts.text: Put down what you have carried.
Where am I? There's nobody here.
scripts.translation: 我在哪儿？这里一个人也没有。

scripts.text: You can see as much as you know. That's why I'm always tired. People all want me to look at them.
scripts.translation: 你能看到多少，取决于你知道多少。所以我才总是这么累，人人都想让我替他们看清一切。

scripts.text: You talk too much! I told you we don't have much time. You can listen to my explanation later. Someone who was standing in front of this detected me already and went inside. We don't know what they will prepare.
scripts.translation: 你话太多了！我说过时间不多，解释之后再说。刚才有人守在这里，发现我之后就进去了。我们不知道他们会有什么准备。

scripts.text: Wait, are we going to leave him here?
scripts.translation: 等等，要把他留在这里吗？

scripts.text: Yeah. Is there any problem? Is it a problem? Could it be a problem?
scripts.translation: 是啊。有问题吗？这有问题吗？这会有问题吗？

scripts.text: You said that we should bring the injured man. Then you told me to carry him all the way here. Now you are abandoning him here?
scripts.translation: 你刚才还说得带上伤者，让我一路把他背到这里。现在却要把他丢在这儿？

scripts.text: Don't worry about him. He's not going to die. Humans do not die so easily. The fact I'm still alive is the evidence.
scripts.translation: 别担心，他死不了。人没那么容易死，我还活着就是证据。

scripts.text: Come on, let's get in. We don't have much time. Let's talk inside. Aren't you curious to know what's in there?
scripts.translation: 快进去，时间不多了。进去再聊。你不好奇里面有什么吗？

scripts.text: We have to see something to get in there.
scripts.translation: 我们得先找到入口才能进去吧。

scripts.text: Look at this. There's an entrance here. This is ^0000cdan entrance hidden in the wall of the beach^000000. It is so fishy. Let's get inside and check what's there.
scripts.translation: 看这里，这里有个入口。入口藏在海滩的墙壁里，真可疑。进去看看里面有什么。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What are you doing? Come in!
Oh, welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation: 哦，欢迎光临。这是克拉纳·内米埃里武器店。

scripts.text: In this store, even a small sound creates a huge resonant due to its structure. Please be quite when entering here.
scripts.translation: 这家店的结构会让细微的声音产生很大的回响。进来时请保持安静。

scripts.text: A real customer!! We have a customer in this period...
scripts.translation: 有客人！！这种时候居然还有客人...

scripts.text: Who are you? This is not a place where anyone can come in. Please leave.
scripts.translation: 你是谁？这里不是谁都能进来的地方。请离开。

scripts.text: Ouch! The store looks smaller that it looks from outside. Is there a space behind the pillar?
scripts.translation: 哎哟！这家店里面看起来比外面还小。柱子后面是不是还有空间？

scripts.text: Welcome. This is ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000 and we handle various firearms.
scripts.translation: 欢迎光临，这里是克拉纳·内米埃里，专营各种枪械。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Take a look around and tell me if there is anything you are looking for.
scripts.translation: 请随意看看，想找什么就告诉我。

scripts.text: Yeah.. I hope we have what you're looking for.
scripts.translation: 嗯...希望这里有你要找的东西。

scripts.text: By the way... How did you find us? This is a small store that only limited people visit.
scripts.translation: 对了...你是怎么找到这里的？这家小店平时没几个人来。

scripts.text: I wanted to buy a self-defense gun. And someone recommended me this store.
scripts.translation: 我想买把防身枪，有人推荐我来这家店。

scripts.text: What would you do if I tell you who that person is?
scripts.translation: 我告诉您那个人是谁，您又打算怎么办？

scripts.text: Wow, this looks cool. Is this the way you hold it?
scripts.translation: 哇，这个看起来挺酷。是这样握的吗？

scripts.text: Sir. That stuff is quite sensitive and you shouldn't tough it inconsiderately.
scripts.translation: 先生，那东西很精密，请不要随便碰。

scripts.text: Didn't you tell me to look all I want? This is so small! Can it ever fire a bullet? Look at the dust here. I guess you're out of business here.
scripts.translation: 不是您让我随便看的吗？这也太小了！真能打出子弹吗？看看上面的灰，看来你们生意不太好啊。

scripts.text: Oh.. That's one of the most popular products in our store.
scripts.translation: 哦...那可是本店最畅销的商品之一。

scripts.text: Is this a popular product? I can imagine the quality of this store.
scripts.translation: 这是畅销货？我都能想象这家店的品质了。

scripts.text: What did you say? Are you insulting my gun now?
scripts.translation: 你说什么？你是在侮辱我的枪吗？

scripts.text: No, I don't mean it. But if you heard it that way, then it's an insult.
scripts.translation: 我不是那个意思。不过您要是这么理解，那就算我侮辱您了。

scripts.text: Calm down, Nemi. He's a customer.
Hmm... This looks quite good. How much is it?
scripts.translation: 嗯...这个看起来不错，多少钱？

scripts.text: That's the price of a snack. Give me one.
scripts.translation: 这价钱跟零食差不多。给我来一把。

scripts.text: Since it is a display product, we have to place an order. There are too many orders and you have to wait for eight months. Can you wait?
scripts.translation: 这是展示品，得另外订购。订单太多，要等八个月。你等得了吗？

scripts.text: I'm not the one who's short-tempered. I guess it's you.
scripts.translation: 脾气急的人可不是我，我看是你吧。

scripts.text: Rather than these, show me what you actually sell here. For example, ^0000cdFast Grinder Cutting through the Wind^000000?
scripts.translation: 比起这些，拿点你们真正卖的东西给我看看。比如疾风切割机？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hey, who the hell are you?
Can't you see? I am a tourist and this is my secretary.
scripts.translation: 看不出来吗？我是游客，这是我的秘书。

scripts.translation: 尤其是知道他穿着反叛者制服之后，更没人愿意帮忙。

scripts.text: By looking at your eyes, I see you haven't come to hear gratitude from us.
scripts.translation: 看你的眼神就知道，你不是来听我们道谢的。

scripts.text: The man called Lazy who came with you...
scripts.translation: 和你一起来的那个懒散...

scripts.text: You helped Gonie by chance. But you didn't come here by chance. Did you?
scripts.translation: 你救戈尼或许是偶然，但你来这里绝不是偶然，对吧？

scripts.text: You'd better think twice before you answer.
Be careful on your way home.
The public order is not so good in this area.
I think you are misunderstanding something.
Surely, I want to express my gratitude for what you did for Gonie.
scripts.translation: 你救了戈尼，我当然想向你道谢。

scripts.text: What you are saying now is a totally different issue.
scripts.translation: 是！你现在说的是另一回事。

scripts.text: The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 我笑了！你既然提起他们，就说明你知道我们和他们的关系，对吧？

scripts.text: If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation: 如果你什么都不知道，那就只是被人利用了。识相的话，赶紧回去吧。

scripts.text: This is all I can tell you.
He must know his position better than anyone else.
scripts.translation: 他应该比谁都清楚自己的处境。那

scripts.text: The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 我笑了！你既然提起他们，就说明你知道我们和他们的关系，对吧？

scripts.text: If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation: 如果你什么都不知道，那就只是被人利用了。识相的话，赶紧回去吧。

scripts.text: This is all I can tell you.
If I didn't see a ghost, you are living a pretty long life. Aren't you?
scripts.translation: 要是我没看错，你还真是命大。

scripts.text: I thought you would leave on your own, if you cared for your life. But you are still hanging around here.
scripts.translation: 赶出去。我还以为惜命的话你早就走了，没想到还赖在这里。

scripts.text: It's so annoying to see this rat wandering around in my space.
scripts.translation: 看这只老鼠在我的地盘上乱窜，真让人心烦。

scripts.text: There's something more important now. Here's a letter from Dien.
scripts.translation: 现在有更重要的事。这是迪恩寄来的信。

scripts.text: It's quite unusual to receive a letter from her.
scripts.translation: 她居然会写信来，真少见。

scripts.text: Let me see... I agree. Do you agree, too?
scripts.translation: 我看看...我同意。你也同意吧？

scripts.text: I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation: .我好像看见了幽灵。你要读读这封信吗？

scripts.text: I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation: .我好像看见了幽灵。你要读读这封信吗？

scripts.text: What the hell... Is that jerk still alive after sending this letter to the commander?
scripts.translation: 搞什么...那个混蛋给指挥官寄了这封信，居然还活着？

scripts.text: He is not the type of a man who would just sit down after listening to it. Is he?
scripts.translation: ？他可不是听完就会袖手旁观的人，对吧？

scripts.text: I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation: 不知道你对他们说了什么，但我还要再和他们谈谈。

scripts.text: You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation: 外面太吵，我就出来看看。原来是你。

scripts.text: I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation: 不知道你对他们说了什么，但我还要再和他们谈谈。

scripts.text: You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation: 外面太吵，我就出来看看。原来是你。

scripts.text: You and I just do not appear to communicate.
scripts.translation: 看来我们就是没法好好沟通。

scripts.text: I didn't know you were so stubborn...
It's all because of you, Dien.
I still remember you telling me a story about them. You were so angry with them. Now you make this choice.
scripts.translation: 。我还记得你以前提起他们时有多愤怒。现在你却做出这种决定。

scripts.text: As you put on years, your memory and judgment are not as good as they used to be.
scripts.translation: 年纪大了，记忆和判断力都不如从前了。

scripts.text: At that time, you were just an infant in diapers. How do you happen to know so much about them?
scripts.translation: 那时候你还只是个穿尿布的婴儿，怎么会知道那么多？

scripts.text: Did you experience that incident yourself?
scripts.translation: 那场事故是你亲身经历的吗？

scripts.text: I'm the one who saved your life during the ravage of war.
scripts.translation: 当年战乱时，是我救了你一命。

scripts.text: And just look at your big mouth now!
Is it the way I taught you?
What the hell are you doing!
Whatever you say, I'm against it!
scripts.translation: 不管你说什么，我都反对！

scripts.text: You are still chattering with the big mouth!
scripts.translation: 你这张嘴还真是停不下来啊！

scripts.text: What are you doing! They are all looking at you!!!!
scripts.translation: 你在干什么！大家都看着呢！！！！

scripts.text: Well, I don't care who's looking at me.
What have you done so far with that vengeance alone?
scripts.translation: 你光想着复仇，这些年到底做成什么了？

scripts.text: Are you going to hate them forever, doing nothing until I die?
scripts.translation: 你打算一直恨他们，什么都不做，直到我死吗？

scripts.text: How many years do you think I have ahead!!!
scripts.translation: 你觉得我还能活多少年！！

scripts.text: By looking at you now, I'm sure you can live for 100 more years!
scripts.translation: 看你现在这精神头，我敢说你还能活一百年！

scripts.text: Let me live for 100 more years and pull out your beard!
scripts.translation: ！那我就再活一百年，把你的胡子拔光！

scripts.text: But you will to have to face the consequences. Be prepared!
scripts.translation: 不过你得承担后果。等着瞧！

scripts.text: That's exactly what I was hoping for.
Tell each senior and commander to gather now.
scripts.translation: 长！通知所有前辈和指挥官，立刻集合。

scripts.text: We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation: 我们会帮你，但别指望我们出太多力。

scripts.text: There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation: 我们没有理由为你们牺牲。

scripts.text: Hey! You are saying this again!
Since you got the approval from Rupert, {0} why don't you go back for report?
scripts.translation: 既然鲁伯特已经同意了，{0}，你回去汇报吧。

scripts.text: It seems like the youngsters will be busy for a while. Please help the old people, whenever you have time.
scripts.translation: 年轻人们接下来会忙一阵子。有空的话，也请帮帮我们这些老人家。

scripts.text: Talk to me before the meeting.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation: 我们会帮你，但别指望我们出太多力。

scripts.text: There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation: 我们没有理由为你们牺牲。

scripts.text: I read it, too. What you have said just now was written there.
scripts.translation: 我也看过了。你刚才说的内容，信里都写了。

scripts.text: The same thing was written in the letter that I handed to Erst.
scripts.translation: 我交给厄斯特的那封信里，写的也是同样的内容。

scripts.text: It's dangerous outside. There are outsiders there.
scripts.translation: 恩！外面有危险，还有外人。

scripts.text: I was about to visit you.
Your letter... What does it mean?

scripts.translation: 信里写的就是我的意思。

scripts.text: Are you saying that you agreed to help the Secret Wings?
scripts.translation: 你是说你同意帮助秘密之翼？

scripts.text: As I wrote in the letter.
Ridsh, Cotnes and I will agree to help the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation: 里德什、科特内斯和我，都同意帮助秘密之翼。

scripts.text: Even Ridsh and Cotnes...? No. I can't believe that you agree to it, even after I have heard it from you personally.
scripts.translation: 连里德什和科特内斯都...？不，我亲耳听你说了，还是不敢相信你们会同意。

scripts.text: I heard Erst agrees as well.
Since there are so many people who agree to it, you should not resist it alone.
scripts.translation: 意了。既然这么多人都赞成，你也别一个人硬扛。

scripts.text: I can't laugh it off this time.
You are the one who knows how silly this is more than anyone else.
scripts.translation: 没人比你更清楚这件事有多荒唐。

scripts.text: We cannot stick on the same spot forever.
Although the time passes, it doesn't mean that the past goes away!
scripts.translation: 时间会流逝，但过去不会因此消失！

scripts.text: We sacrificed too much to forget it!
scripts.translation: 我们已经付出太多，怎么可能忘掉！

scripts.text: Regarding this issue, I, as the person in charge here, will decide on it.
scripts.translation: 这件事由我负责，我会做决定。

scripts.text: Trying to respect you as a senior, I have overlooked your behavior so far. However, this time, you crossed the line.
scripts.translation: 我一直尊重你是前辈，才容忍你到现在。但这次你越界了。

scripts.text: Now! Please go back to your room and enjoy your tea party.
I can't ignore what you've just said.
scripts.translation: ！你刚才那番话我不能当没听见

scripts.text: Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation: 。你是想无视我的意见，连我这个人也一起无视吗？

scripts.text: I can't ignore what you've just said.
scripts.translation: ！我不能当没听见你刚才那番话

scripts.text: Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation: 。你是想无视我的意见，连我这个人也一起无视吗？

scripts.text: I joined the Rebellion, because their shooting looked so cool to me. But now I am so busy handling the documents that I have no time to get my hands on a gun.
scripts.translation: 我加入反叛者，是因为他们开枪的样子很帅。可现在整天忙着整理文件，连摸枪的时间都没有。

scripts.text: The problem is that I feel like this work suits me.
scripts.translation: 问题是，我觉得这工作还挺适合我。

scripts.text: When I'm lucky, I can get some snacks from seniors.
scripts.translation: 运气好的时候，前辈们还会给我些零食。

scripts.text: It's amazing that the taste is different when I purchase the snacks myself.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪，自己买来的零食吃起来就是不一样。

scripts.text: Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation: 你怎么带这么多东西？把背包腾空些，才好装新战利品。

scripts.text: Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation: 你怎么带这么多东西？把背包腾空些，才好装新战利品。

scripts.text: Oh~ It's wonderful here. It's so cozy. ^0000cdWhat is this place for^000000? I want to stay here for a day.
scripts.translation: 哦~这里真棒，好舒服。这是什么地方？我想在这儿待一天。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I never imagined there would be a place like this behind the store... What's this?
scripts.translation: 我真没想到商店后面还有这种地方...这里是做什么的？

scripts.text: A sanatorium that looks after novices and senior citizens. There is nothing to see here. And it's too cold in here and your mouth might be twisted if you sleep here. That's why you'd better leave after drinking the tea.
scripts.translation: 这是照顾新手和老人的疗养院，没什么好看的。这里还很冷，睡在这儿嘴巴可能会冻歪，喝完茶就赶紧走吧。

scripts.text: You are too stingy. How can you do this to me after I saved his life?
scripts.translation: 你也太小气了。我好歹救了他的命，你怎么能这样？

scripts.text: I gave you a cup of tea and I promised you to compensate. What else do you need?
scripts.translation: 我给你倒了茶，也答应补偿你了。你还想要什么？

scripts.text: There are things you cannot buy.
scripts.translation: 有些东西是钱买不到的。

scripts.text: Well, then, you're leaving me with my gratitude.
scripts.translation: 好吧，那我就只好心怀感激了。

scripts.text: No. According to my experience so far, everything that I cannot buy is useless.
scripts.translation: 不。照我的经验，买不到的东西都没用。

scripts.text: I can't figure out what you want. Have a sit there anyway. I will give you a cup of tea that you desired.
scripts.translation: 我真搞不懂你要什么。先坐下吧，我给你泡杯你想喝的茶。

scripts.text: Lucky~~~ Where have you been!! I've been waiting for a while! I'm going out for a mission and wish me a good luck.
scripts.translation: 拉基~~~你去哪儿了！！我等了好一会儿！我要出任务了，祝我好运吧。

scripts.text: Rookie!!!! Help me arrange the warehouse quickly. There are bunch of them and I can't do it alone. Hurry up.
scripts.translation: 新人！！快来帮我整理仓库！东西太多了，我一个人忙不过来。快点！

scripts.text: Hey, I came before you. Didn't I?
I have a customer. I will get to you after giving them cups of tea. Both of you, please wait a minute.
scripts.translation: 我还有客人，等给他们上完茶就来。你们两个先等一下。

scripts.text: I can wait! I cannot put pressure on Lucky.
scripts.translation: 我可以等！我不能催拉基。

scripts.text: They are looking for you everywhere. You are so popular. Aren't you?
scripts.translation: 大家到处找你呢，你还真受欢迎啊。

scripts.text: Rookie, where have you been? Everyone's looking for you.
scripts.translation: 新人，你跑哪儿去了？大家都在找你。

scripts.text: He has healthy legs, so he can go around.
scripts.translation: 他腿脚好着呢，能自己到处跑。

scripts.text: Lucky, bring a cup of tea.
Lucky, they are strangers. Who are they?
scripts.translation: 拉基，这两个人是谁？看着面生。

scripts.text: They saved Gonie's life. They came to this quiet Einbech. They found injured Gonie ^0000cdaccidentally^000000 and healed him. Then they brought him ^0000cdright^000000 here.
scripts.translation: 他们救了戈尼的命，还专程来到这偏僻的艾音贝赫。他们偶然发现受伤的戈尼，治好他后，又正好把他送来了这里。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes. I did it. I did it!
You take too much credit to yourself after helping someone.
scripts.translation: 你帮了人就这么爱居功吗？

scripts.text: You have to exaggerate your performance. That's the way to be appreciated by others.
scripts.translation: 得把功劳说得夸张点，别人才会赏识你嘛。

scripts.text: So, why did you come here? By the way, who are you?
scripts.translation: 那么，你们来这里做什么？对了，你们是谁？

scripts.text: Me? Lazy. Although it's not my real name, call me Lazy now.
scripts.translation: 我？叫我懒散就行，虽然这不是真名。

scripts.text: I am an, ^0000cdagent of Secret Wings^000000, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation: 我是秘密之翼的特工，该机构直接向施瓦茨瓦尔特总统负责。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hey! Why did you tell them who you are all of a sudden? You kept telling me not even to mention it. And you revealed it officially!
scripts.translation: 喂！你怎么突然把身份说出来了？你之前还一直叫我别提这件事，结果自己倒是公开说了！

scripts.text: It's all right. This is our destination. ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000, the stronghold of Rebellions.
scripts.translation: 没关系，这里就是我们的目的地——克拉纳·内米埃里，反叛者的据点。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Then the store outside the door was a ^0000cdtrickery^000000. The collapsed man is a member of ^0000cdRebellion^000000... That's why...
scripts.translation: 所以门外那家店只是个幌子，那个倒下的人是反叛者成员...我明白了... ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hey, calm down please! Put your guns in! No wonder you are hot headed elders!!
scripts.translation: 喂，冷静点！把枪收起来！难怪你们这些老前辈脾气这么火爆！！

scripts.text: Although they have come here with a fishy purpose, it's true that they carried injured Gonie all the way here. Behave yourself, old men.
scripts.translation: 他们的目的虽然可疑，但确实一路把受伤的戈尼背了过来。你们这些老家伙，冷静点。

scripts.text: You are not surprised? So you knew it.
scripts.translation: 你一点也不惊讶？看来你早就知道了。

scripts.text: I didn't know who you were. But I knew you had a certain purpose. I had not told you my name but you were shouting 'Come out Rookie'. So I had a clue.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你们是谁，但知道你们另有目的。我还没告诉你名字，你就在喊“新人出来”，这让我起了疑心。

scripts.text: I heard that the brain of a Rebellion is filled with bullets, but maybe not every Rebellion! So, is your name Lucky, or Rookie?
scripts.translation: 我听说反叛者个个脑子里都装着子弹，不过看来也不是所有人都这样嘛！所以你到底叫拉基还是新人？

scripts.text: Rookie! You already knew who he was, and you..!!
scripts.translation: 新人！你早就知道他们是谁了吧？你这家伙...！

scripts.text: I told you! Old men, are you deaf now? I didn't know who they were! This is unfair!
scripts.translation: 我说了，我不知道他们是谁！老家伙们，你们聋了吗？这不公平！

scripts.text: If they had an intention to attack us, they would have done it already, rather than asking for tea. And what can these two do against many of us?
scripts.translation: 他们要是想袭击我们，早就动手了，何必坐下来喝茶？而且就他们两个，能拿我们这么多人怎么样？

scripts.text: Whatever they do, you are going to handle them. Aren't you? You are legends of the Rebellion.
scripts.translation: 不管他们打什么主意，你们这些反叛者传奇人物肯定能应付吧？

scripts.text: I don't know where they come from. But by the time they came all the way here, perhaps they need to talk to the seniors. I will bring the tea and enjoy the talk.
scripts.translation: 我不知道他们来自哪里，但他们大老远赶来，肯定有事要和前辈们谈。我去泡茶，顺便听听。

scripts.text: Hahaha! Nice to meet you. Did I surprise you by coming in all of a sudden in leisure hours?
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈！很高兴见到各位。我突然在休息时间来访，没打扰你们吧？

scripts.text: But I am not a dangerous person, so please relax. And this adventurer is much less dangerous.
scripts.translation: 不过我不是什么危险人物，放轻松。至于这位冒险者，就更没什么威胁了。

scripts.text: This person is an adventurer who settled various problems of the continent, including Schwaltzvalt. The adventurer is currently under the protection of Rune Midgarts Kingdom.{0}
scripts.translation: 这位冒险者解决过大陆各地的问题，包括施瓦茨瓦尔特的麻烦，目前受到卢恩·米德加兹王国的保护。 {0}

scripts.text: And I am a member of Secret Wings, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt Republic. Since the President guarantees my identification, you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation: 我是秘密之翼的成员，直接向施瓦茨瓦尔特共和国总统负责。总统能证明我的身份，你们不用担心。

scripts.text: You are the most dangerous guy here!
scripts.translation: 你才是这里最危险的人！

scripts.text: President? Since I heard that unpleasant word, let me wash my ears!
scripts.translation: 总统？光听到这个讨厌的词，我就想洗洗耳朵！

scripts.text: What is a spoiled crow of the President doing here?
scripts.translation: 总统的宠儿跑到这里来干什么？

scripts.text: That's what I am about to tell you now. Haha. So please put your guns down... Let's sit down first.
scripts.translation: 这正是我要解释的事。哈哈，先把枪放下...我们坐下来谈吧。

scripts.text: Hey, you are standing up too!
Ahaha. I've got a disease that I can't sit down. By the way... As a guest, I couldn't come here with empty hands. This is a specialty good of Yuno... Please have some.
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈，我有病，坐不下来。对了...既然是客人，总不能空手来。这是尤诺特产...请尝尝。

scripts.text: What do you mean by guest? We never invited you.
scripts.translation: 你算什么客人？我们可没邀请你。

scripts.text: We never know what you put on this food! There is nothing we would like to hear from you. So get out of here!
scripts.translation: 谁知道你在食物里下了什么！我们没什么要听的，滚出去！

scripts.text: As soon as you drink the tea, leave at once~ We won't see you off!
scripts.translation: 喝完就赶紧走~我们可不送你！

scripts.text: Where are you going? I brought the tea in reference to the number of people here.
scripts.translation: 你去哪儿？我可是照人数把茶都拿来了。

scripts.text: I don't drink tea in uncomfortable place. I don't want to have an upset stomach while drinking tea.
scripts.translation: 我才不在这种不自在的地方喝茶，免得喝得胃不舒服。

scripts.text: Come on, what's wrong with you~ You can drink it so quickly. It's not good after it gets cold. Your stomach must have got cold by now. You're not so healthy either.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，你这是怎么了~茶得趁热喝，凉了就不好了。你的胃八成已经着凉了，身体也不太好嘛。

scripts.text: Can't you just drink the tea before leaving? I struggled to get this tea... You also liked it...
scripts.translation: 喝完茶再走不行吗？我费了好大劲才弄到这些茶...你明明也喜欢喝...

scripts.text: And if we feel uncomfortable, they also feel uncomfortable. So it's not such a bad condition. Come on. Drinking a cup of tea is not a hard thing to do.
scripts.translation: 而且我们不舒服，他们也会不舒服，这不正好吗？来吧，喝杯茶又不难。

scripts.text: I mean, the spoiled crow of the President-
Please. The tea is innocent. have a peaceful tea time. Never fight in front of food. You taught me all these words. Didn't you?
scripts.translation: 拜托，茶是无辜的。大家好好喝茶，别在食物面前争吵。这些话不都是你教我的吗？

scripts.text: Wow~ This tea is great. It matches well with this specialty good. Try it. The President prepared it for you.
scripts.translation: 哇~这茶真好喝，配这道特色点心正合适。尝尝吧，这是总裁特意为你准备的。

scripts.text: Please listen to me. I'm here to ask you a very difficult request.
scripts.translation: 请听我说。我这次来，是想拜托你们一件非常棘手的事。

scripts.text: Why should we accept a difficult request?
scripts.translation: 我们为什么要接受一个困难的请求？

scripts.text: That's why I came here. This mission cannot be accomplished by anyone except Rebellion. So the President sent me here.
scripts.translation: 所以我才来这里。这项任务只有反叛者才能完成，总裁才派我前来。

scripts.text: I think it will be such a confidential and cautious story. Please take this...
scripts.translation: 这件事需要高度保密，也得谨慎处理。请先收下这个...

scripts.text: Yes! Although you pretend not to know, it's the story you all know.
scripts.translation: 是的！虽然你们装作不知道，但这其实是你们都知道的故事。

scripts.text: The President certainly regrets what happened in the past. His excellency has always been thinking about you and wanted to start a talk.
scripts.translation: 总裁确实对过去发生的事感到后悔。他一直挂念着你们，也想找机会谈一谈。

scripts.text: Upon your approval, his excellency wants to meet you in person, apologize, and wants to have an opportunity to harmonize with you.
scripts.translation: 只要你们同意，总裁就想亲自与你们见面道歉，希望有机会修复彼此的关系。

scripts.text: I was also extremely sad to hear what happened to you. And I was looking for a chance to meet you and talk to you.
scripts.translation: 听说你们遭遇了那些事，我也非常难过。我一直想找机会和你们见面聊聊。

scripts.text: You are so cool. I like it. Then I will get down to the business.
scripts.translation: 你们真酷。我喜欢这样。那么我就直入正题了。

scripts.text: [Lazy began to talk about what happened recently and the request of the President.]
scripts.translation: [懒散开始讲起最近发生的事，以及总裁的请求。]

scripts.text: I see. But it's your business and I don't get why we should help you. Do I?
scripts.translation: 我明白了。但这是你们的事，我不懂我们为什么要帮忙。对吧？

scripts.text: You ignored us when we were in trouble. And you are asking for help now? How can you do that?
scripts.translation: 我们遇到困难时，你们对我们不闻不问。现在却来求我们帮忙？哪有这样的道理？

scripts.text: Sounds like a bunch of nonsense. I don't want to listen any more.
scripts.translation: 简直是一派胡言。我不想再听了。

scripts.text: That won't harm you under any circumstances!
scripts.translation: 无论如何，这都不会伤害到你们！

scripts.text: The adventurer approved by the royal family of Rune Midgarts is together with us in this mission.
scripts.translation: 这次任务还有一位得到卢恩·米德加兹王室认可的冒险者与我们同行。

scripts.text: With the cooperation of Schwaltzvalt President and Rune Midgarts Kingdom, you can now use the power of the adventurer.
scripts.translation: 施瓦茨瓦尔特总统与卢恩·米德加兹王国携手合作，如今你们也能借助这位冒险者的力量。

scripts.text: Why would we need the power of the adventurer?
scripts.translation: 我们为什么需要冒险者的力量？

scripts.text: How can we trust a stranger? Are you going to stab us in the back again?
scripts.translation: 我们怎么能信任一个陌生人？难道你又要背后捅我们一刀吗？

scripts.text: This is your opportunity. Along with this cooperation, you can eliminate the dishonor!
scripts.translation: 这是你们的机会。通过这次合作，你们可以洗刷耻辱！

scripts.text: If you cannot trust the President, please trust the adventurer and the royal family of Rune Midgarts. They have already promised a full support.
scripts.translation: 如果你们无法信任总裁，请相信这位冒险者和卢恩·米德加兹王室。他们已经承诺全力支持。

scripts.text: That's right! If you need my help, I will support you actively.
scripts.translation: 没错！如果你需要我的帮助，我会积极支持你。

scripts.text: This is not a matter of benefits. It's about our feeling!
scripts.translation: 这不是利益问题，而是我们的感受！

scripts.text: Lucky, thanks for the tea. Send them now. Let the crow go back to its nest.
scripts.translation: 拉基，谢谢你的茶。现在送他们走吧，让乌鸦回巢。

scripts.text: We will never see them again. So send them gently. Rookie.
scripts.translation: 我们再也不会见他们了。新人，客气地送他们离开吧。

scripts.text: Please, you can't leave like this...!!!
scripts.translation: 拜托，你们不能就这样离开...!!!

scripts.text: Hmm... I knew it would be difficult. But I'm surprised that they are not even listening to me.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我知道这会很困难。但没想到他们连我的话都不肯听。

scripts.text: Phew. These old men will never change.
scripts.translation: 呼。这些老头子永远不会变。

scripts.text: You know it already. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation: 你早就知道了。为什么还要问？

scripts.text: Sorry. I guess I made a wrong judgment. I should have collected more accurate information.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我判断错了。我本该先收集更准确的情报。

scripts.text: What's wrong with you? You make me nervous.
scripts.translation: 你到底怎么了？你让我感到不安。

scripts.text: Before I came here, I knew people who were sitting here had the authority, but I now realize that it is a little different.
scripts.translation: 来之前，我知道坐在这里的人有话语权，但现在看来，实际情况并非如此。

scripts.text: Unless you live here, it's hard to find out who has the authority.
scripts.translation: 如果不是住在这里的人，很难弄清楚究竟谁说了算。

scripts.text: I don't know what you are talking about. If you finished drinking the tea, please leave.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在说什么。如果你茶喝完了，请离开。

scripts.text: Rookie, please help us. If you think about it, you can tell that it's a win-win proposition. You don't want to hide yourself in this corner of the woods forever, do you?
scripts.translation: 新人，请帮帮我们。仔细想想，这对双方都有好处。你不想永远躲在这片森林的角落里吧？

scripts.text: You know that this is the opportunity to take advantage of the government's support and compassion for you. It will provide better fundamentals for Rebellions.
scripts.translation: 这是借助政府支持、改善你们处境的机会。这也能为反叛者打下更好的基础。

scripts.text: If this works well. you'll be free to work in Schwaltzvalt and Rune Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 如果一切顺利，你们就能自由往来于施瓦茨瓦尔特和卢恩·米德加兹王国。

scripts.text: Look at this place. It's just a tiny shop. Can you call it headquarters? Don't you want to reclaim your glory?
scripts.translation: 看看这里，不过是间小店，哪像总部？你们不想重振昔日荣光吗？

scripts.text: And when we are in trouble, you'll abandon us again. There are still many people who haven't washed the wound from what happened in the past. Do you really think they'll help you?
scripts.translation: 可我们一遇到麻烦，你们就会再次抛弃我们。过去发生的事留下的创伤，许多人至今还没愈合。你真觉得他们会帮你们吗？

scripts.text: That's why I am asking for your help. I guess you can change their mind by persuading them.
scripts.translation: 所以我才请求你的帮助。我想你可以说服他们改变主意。

scripts.text: In every place, there is a hidden key person who moves the whole group even though you cannot that person easily. Here, it's you.
scripts.translation: 每个团体里都有一位隐藏的关键人物，平时不容易被人发现，却能推动整个团体。在这里，那个人就是你。

scripts.text: Well, I guess you are overrating me. They regard me as an unimportant guy here. I dont't take any important mission. All I do is errands and clean-ups. Do you honestly think I'm a key person?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我想你太高看我了。这里的人觉得我无足轻重。我从没接过重要任务，只负责跑腿和打扫。你真觉得我是关键人物吗？

scripts.text: No, no. That's not what I am talking about. Normally they call it a mood maker.
scripts.translation: 不，不是那个意思。通常大家会把这种人称作“气氛担当”。

scripts.text: A while ago, you convinced the old men to listen to me. That's what I am talking about. You have such abilities.
scripts.translation: 刚才你说服了那些老前辈听我把话说完。我指的就是这个，你有这种本事。

scripts.text: I don't know what you mean by 'such abilities'. But I guess you have nothing to talk about by now. The seniors are gone.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你说的“这种本事”是什么。不过现在你也没什么可说的了，前辈们都走了。

scripts.text: That's why I'm trying to help you. Please convince others.
scripts.translation: 所以我才试图帮助你。请说服其他人。

scripts.text: I have nowhere else to go. Neither does everyone else here. We cannot just help you trusting your promise.
scripts.translation: 我无处可去，这里其他人也一样。我们不能只凭你的一句承诺就帮你们。

scripts.text: It may be a matter of cooperation for you. But for us, it's a matter of survival.
scripts.translation: 对你来说，这可能只是合作的问题。但对我们来说，这是生死攸关的问题。

scripts.text: Please. We are also desperate. The fates of the royal family of a country and another country are in danger.
scripts.translation: 求求你们。我们也已经走投无路。两个国家的王室都危在旦夕。

scripts.text: But if you help us, we can sort it out. That's something only you can do. We really need your help.
scripts.translation: 但如果你帮了我们，一切都能解决。这是只有你能做到的事。我们真的需要你的帮助。

scripts.text: If you really need help, go to someone else.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的需要帮助，去找别人吧。

scripts.text: You are as cold as ice. How merciless. Please show some mercy and help us.
scripts.translation: 你冷得像冰一样。真是无情。请发发慈悲，帮帮我们吧。

scripts.text: The people who were sitting here are seniors. They are anchors and symbols of Rebellions.
scripts.translation: 刚才坐在这里的都是前辈。他们是反叛者的支柱，也是反叛者的象征。

scripts.text: But as they got old, they retired from the front line. Now they drink tea and watch the junior Rebellions grow up.
scripts.translation: 但他们年纪大了，已经从前线退下来。如今他们喝茶，看着年轻一代的反叛者成长。

scripts.text: So other people are responsible for all the inside jobs. They are the ones ^0000cdwho move the Rebellion practically^000000. They are decision makers.
scripts.translation: 所以内部事务都由其他人负责。他们才是实际推动反叛者运作的人，也是做决定的人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: If you convince them, the public opinion change. Once the public opinion changes, what can seniors do about it?
scripts.translation: 如果你说服了他们，舆论就会改变。舆论一旦转向，前辈们还能怎么办？

scripts.text: Thank you. I prefer those who are wise and smart like you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你。我更喜欢像你这样明智聪明的人。

scripts.text: In my opinion, I think it's better for us to be accepted in a wide world rather than living here like this.
scripts.translation: 我觉得，与其像现在这样困在这里，不如让外面的广阔世界接纳我们。

scripts.text: Adventurer, it's time for you to take an action. Please persuade them.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，是时候采取行动了。请说服他们。

scripts.text: Did you seen the response from the seniors? Once I introduce myself, they might shoot at me make dozens of holes in my body.
scripts.translation: 你没看到前辈们的反应吗？我要是自报家门，他们说不定会朝我开枪，把我打成筛子。

scripts.text: Since those seniors were relatively rational, we are alive and talking like this. If only there was one person with a short-temper... Phew...
scripts.translation: 幸好那些前辈还算理智，我们才能像现在这样活着聊天。要是其中有个暴脾气的...呼...

scripts.text: Adventurer. You are a symbol of faith. Please go and show them your faith. That will take care of everything. Did you see what I did a moment ago? Do as I did.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你是大家信赖的象征。去向他们证明这一点吧，这样一切都会迎刃而解。刚才我做的你看到了吧？照着做就行。

scripts.text: They are in the ^0000cdroom in the 2nd floor2^000000. You can go up and meet them.
scripts.translation: 他们在二楼的房间。你可以上去见他们。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Do you see the rooms on the 2nd floor? I don't know how many of them are there. But you only have to meet the most important people.
scripts.translation: 你看到二楼的房间了吗？我不知道那里有多少个房间。但你只需要见最重要的人。

scripts.text: Let's see... You meet ^0000cdRupert^000000, the strict gentleman and ^0000cdElena^000000, the hunting dog first.
scripts.translation: 让我想想...你先去见鲁伯特，那位严厉的绅士；再见埃琳娜，那条猎犬。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: By the way, never call Elena 'hunting dog' in front of her. She's going to disintegrate you.
scripts.translation: 顺便说一句，千万别在埃琳娜面前叫她“猎犬”。她会把你撕碎的。

scripts.text: Anyone else...? Oh, the next one is the good-hearted ^0000cdold women, I mean ladies^000000. Then you meet the Special Force commander ^0000cdErst^000000...
scripts.translation: 还有谁...？哦，接下来是心地善良的老太太——我是说女士们。然后是特种部队指挥官厄斯特... ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can meet these ^0000cdfour teams^000000 and talk to them. As I told you earlier, be careful when you talk. Some of them are short-tempered.
scripts.translation: 你可以去见这四支队伍，并和他们交谈。正如我之前所说，说话时要小心。其中有些人脾气很暴躁。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, good luck! I will be talking to Rookie. Cheer up.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，祝你好运！我去和新人聊聊。加油。

scripts.text: Adventurer! How was it? You met all of them and persuaded them? Not yet? I guess not. If you go to the 2nd floor, you can meet all of them.
scripts.translation: 冒险者！怎么样？大家都见到了，也说服他们了吗？还没有？我猜也是。上二楼就能见到他们。

scripts.text: I will be cheering for you. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation: 我会为你加油的。去吧，冒险者！

scripts.text: You're back! So, have you met them? Are they going to help us?
scripts.translation: 你回来了！那么，你见到他们了吗？他们会帮助我们吗？

scripts.text: Yes... Several things happened, but they were not bad.
scripts.translation: 是的...中间虽然出了些状况，但结果还不错。

scripts.text: No wonder you are a symbol of faith!! Now, we can wait for seniors and staffs. Right?
scripts.translation: 难怪你是大家信赖的象征！现在只要等前辈和其他成员回来就行了，对吧？

scripts.text: Come on. Sit here and listen to Rookie's story. It's so interesting.
scripts.translation: 来吧。坐在这里听听新人的故事。非常有趣。

scripts.text: So, why did you leave your home?
It's quite obvious. My family had a secondhand store. As you know, the amount iron consumption is so great in this area. Some people joke that they steal your spoon while your eyes are closed.
scripts.translation: 这还用问吗？我家开了家二手店。你知道，这一带的铁消耗量很大。有人还开玩笑说，趁你闭眼的时候，连勺子都会被偷走。

scripts.text: Normally they use the iron dug from mines. But since it cannot meet the demands, a lot of used iron is also consumed. Our family bought the iron and resold it.
scripts.translation: 平时大家用的是矿里挖出来的铁，但产量满足不了需求，所以也会大量使用废铁。我们家就是收购废铁再转卖。

scripts.text: And you were not able to help them?
My brothers helped my parents. As you see, I'm so small and used to be sick when I was a kid.
scripts.translation: 我哥哥们都能帮父母做事。你看我这么瘦小，小时候还经常生病。

scripts.text: Oh, so they regarded you as a useless kid?
scripts.translation: 哦，所以他们把你看作一个无用的小孩？

scripts.text: I don't agree with you. Everyone has different ability and you must be good at something. You just didn't find it earlier. Anyway, what happened next?
scripts.translation: 我不同意你的看法。每个人都有不同的能力，你肯定擅长某些事情。你只是之前没发现而已。总之，后来发生了什么？

scripts.text: As my family ignored me, I decided to leave the house to find something I am capable of.
scripts.translation: 既然家人忽视我，我决定离开家，去寻找我擅长的事情。

scripts.text: Well done. If you stayed there, you would have become such a useless person.
scripts.translation: 做得好。如果你留在那里，就会变成一个那样无用的人。

scripts.text: Then I met Gonie and came here. But I found that there's nothing I could do here as well.
scripts.translation: 然后我遇到了戈尼，并来到了这里。但我发现这里也没有我能做的事情。

scripts.text: Everyone is a monster here. Look at Gonie. He was bleeding and almost dead. But He was still alive. The truth is that other guys are extraordinary and you are normal.
scripts.translation: 这里人人都是怪物。看看戈尼，他浑身是血，几乎快死了，却还是活了下来。说到底，别人都身怀绝技，只有你是个普通人。

scripts.text: But I'm not at the level they require here. Whenever I get a gun in my hand, my eyes are sore and my hands are shaking. I can't aim a target properly...
scripts.translation: 可我达不到这里的要求。每次拿起枪，眼睛就酸痛，手也会发抖，根本瞄不准目标...

scripts.text: So you are in charge of the housekeeping here?
scripts.translation: 所以你是负责这里的家务？

scripts.text: Not a housekeeping. A sort of cleaning-up?
scripts.translation: 不是家务。算是打扫清理吧？

scripts.text: Hey Rookie. Why did you bring those jerks in here? They are wandering around and humiliating us! Rookie, are you a spy from the government?
scripts.translation: 嘿，新人。你为什么要带那些混蛋进来？他们到处乱逛，简直是在羞辱我们！新人，你是政府的间谍吗？

scripts.text: The government ignored us when we were dying! We can never help them!
scripts.translation: 政府在我们垂死挣扎时对我们视而不见！我们绝不能帮他们！

scripts.text: Have you forgotten why we are hiding here?
scripts.translation: 你忘了我们为什么躲在这里吗？
这场悲剧是政府造成的！

scripts.text: Fine. You live forever in this isolated place! But what about the children who don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation: 好吧。你就在这与世隔绝的地方永远生活下去吧！但那些对此一无所知的孩子怎么办？

scripts.text: Hey kid! Do you know how much pain we had on that day?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小孩！你知道那天我们遭受了多少痛苦吗？

scripts.text: I don't know! However, no one else will know it unless we talk about it. Go out there and ask anyone.
scripts.translation: 我不知道！但如果我们不谈论它，其他人也不会知道。走出去问问任何人吧。

scripts.text: Ask them if they know that happened on that day. I bet nobody does. Unless we talk about it, how can anyone ever find it out?
scripts.translation: 问问他们是否知道那天发生了什么。我敢打赌没人知道。除非我们说出来，否则没人能发现真相。

scripts.text: You hate to help the government that once abandoned us? It shows that we used to be nothing for them, but now they our help. Does that mean some compensation for us?
scripts.translation: 你讨厌帮助那个曾经抛弃我们的政府？这说明我们过去对他们一文不值，如今他们却需要我们的帮助。这不正好可以作为对我们的补偿吗？

scripts.text: If they need our help, we can just use them. We are not as weak as we used to.
scripts.translation: 如果他们需要我们帮忙，我们可以利用他们。我们不再像以前那样弱小了。

scripts.text: If you want a revenge, maybe this is the opportunity! A revenge doesn't always mean an armed revenge.
scripts.translation: 如果你想复仇，也许这就是机会！复仇未必非得动武。

scripts.text: You are young and not wise enough. No matter what happens, we are never helping the government. Never!
scripts.translation: 你还年轻，不够明智。无论发生什么，我们绝不会帮助政府。绝不！

scripts.text: What the hell is he saying after showing up all of a sudden?
scripts.translation: 他突然出现，到底在说什么鬼话？

scripts.text: Are you still doing the silent meditation?
scripts.translation: 你还在进行无声冥想吗？

scripts.text: Did you hear that? He is in the middle of a silent meditation. How spiteful!
scripts.translation: 听到了吗？他正在进行无声冥想。真够恶毒的！

scripts.text: Be quiet. I hear it all.
... Gonie says we have to pay for the favor they did to him.
scripts.translation: ...戈尼说，我们必须报答他们对他的恩情。

scripts.text: Well. They did the favor for you, not for us.
scripts.translation: 哼。那是他帮了你，不是帮了我们。

scripts.text: If you want to help them so badly, you two go and help them. But make sure you take the clothes off!
scripts.translation: 你们俩要是这么想帮他们，就自己去吧。不过记得把衣服脱了！

scripts.text: Did you hear that? They are so cool.
He says everyone on the 2nd floor decided to help them.
scripts.translation: 他说二楼的人都决定要帮他们。

scripts.text: What? The ladies and Rupert as well?
scripts.translation: 什么？连女士们和鲁伯特也一起？

scripts.text: If you are curious, go upstairs and check it. They might slap you on the back.
scripts.translation: 好奇的话就上楼看看吧。他们说不定还会拍拍你的肩膀呢。

scripts.text: Seems like most of us agree. I don't think anything good will happen if you're still against it.
scripts.translation: 看来大家都同意了。如果你还反对，恐怕不会有什么好事发生。

scripts.text: Phew... Sir, what would you do now? Hehe.
scripts.translation: 呼...前辈，您接下来打算怎么办？呵呵。

scripts.text: Oops... We have no other choice if the ladies and Rupert agreed with them...
scripts.translation: 哎呀...既然女士们和鲁伯特都答应了...我们也只能照办了...

scripts.text: But I will never trust you guys! I will keep my eyes on you!!!
scripts.translation: 但我永远不会信任你们！我会一直盯着你们的！！！

scripts.text: Oh, what a passionate propose. I've never had anything like this in my life. I feel a little shy.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，多么热情的提议！我这辈子还没遇到过这种事，真让人有点不好意思。

scripts.text: I'm not leaving until I close his big mouth! I'm not leaving!
scripts.translation: 在他闭上那张大嘴之前，我不会离开！我不走！

scripts.text: Yes. Let me handle this place. You go inside and get ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，这里交给我处理。你们进去准备吧。

scripts.text: I've never imagined that this would be done so perfectly. I owe you for this. Thanks.
scripts.translation: 我从未想过事情会如此完美地解决。我欠你一个人情。谢谢。

scripts.text: Please go and send them a message. Tell them 'The Heron spread its wings' and they will understand.
scripts.translation: 请去给他们送个信。告诉他们“鹭鸟展翅”，他们就会明白的。

scripts.text: Should I go alone? Don't you have to send the message directly?
scripts.translation: 我要一个人去吗？难道你不应该亲自送信吗？

scripts.text: I am staying here. Hahaha. I really like this fellow and we can work together.
scripts.translation: 我要留在这里。哈哈哈。我挺喜欢这小伙子的，我们可以一起做事。

scripts.text: Work with me? I don't think I can do anything useful for you.
scripts.translation: 跟我合作？我觉得我帮不上什么忙。

scripts.text: Exactly. That's something you should change. Self-confidence. In your case, the lack of confidence caused the lack of self-confidence.
scripts.translation: 没错。这正是你需要改掉的——缺乏自信。你只是不够自信而已。

scripts.text: Confidence can be obtained by yourself, through an achievement or by being approved by someone else a person. It's impossible here. This place is like a suit that does not fit for you.
scripts.translation: 自信可以靠自己取得成就，也可以来自他人的认可。在这里你很难做到。这个地方就像一套不合身的衣服。

scripts.text: As long as there is just one person who trusts you, you can grow to infinity.
scripts.translation: 只要有一个人信任你，你就能无限成长。

scripts.text: You may not have realized it. But you are already doing it to everyone here. They all counting on you. Just trust yourself a little more.
scripts.translation: 你可能还没意识到，但你已经让这里每个人都有了信心。他们都指望着你，多相信自己一点吧。

scripts.text: If you don't get it, trust me. Because I trust you.
scripts.translation: 如果你不明白，那就相信我。因为我信任你。

scripts.text: Now the generation has shifted. Today is the last day for the old generation and the first day for the new generation. And you are the link.
scripts.translation: 现在世代交替了。今天是旧时代的最后一天，也是新时代的第一天。而你就是连接两者的纽带。

scripts.text: You're too good to waste your talent here.
scripts.translation: 你太优秀了，不该在这里浪费才华。

scripts.text: First, you had the ability to find out that I had a certain purpose. You were also able to find out what's helpful for Rebellions. Then you had the guts to implement it. You also have the humanity...
scripts.translation: 首先，你能看出我另有目的，也发现了什么对反叛者有帮助；之后还敢付诸行动。而且你很有人情味...

scripts.text: Just a little polishing will help you spread your wings. You're supposed to use your brain. Why do you suffer by working physically?
scripts.translation: 只要稍加磨练，你就能展翅高飞。你明明该发挥头脑，为什么要靠体力活受苦呢？

scripts.text: If you want, I can help you. What do you think? I need a partner and I'm sure we can make a great duo.
scripts.translation: 如果你愿意，我可以帮你。你觉得怎么样？我需要搭档，我相信我们能组成很棒的双人组。

scripts.text: Oh, could you be explain it to me in detail?
scripts.translation: 哦，你能详细解释一下吗？

scripts.text: Sure. I have plenty of time. By the way, is it okay for me to stay here continuously?
scripts.translation: 当然。我有的是时间。顺便问一下，我可以一直留在这里吗？

scripts.text: We are now cooperating, aren't we?
scripts.translation: 我们现在不是正在合作吗？

scripts.text: Don't you think you're scouting him too plainly in someone else's house?
scripts.translation: 你在别人家里这么明目张胆地挖人，不觉得太过分吗？

scripts.text: Is there anything wrong with it? You have this talented guy but you are not utilizing his ability. Are you? He's so talented!
scripts.translation: 这有什么不对？你身边明明有这么有才华的人，却不让他发挥本领吗？他可是很有才能的！

scripts.text: He says we have prepared someone to proceed the cooperation. If you go to the passage to the store, you can meet that person.
scripts.translation: 他说我们已经安排了人来负责合作事宜。你去商店那边的通道，就能见到那个人。

scripts.text: Yes. I will meet that person and listen.
scripts.translation: 好的。我会去见那个人并听他怎么说。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I need to have a long talk from now on. So I'm counting on you. When you go there, don't forget to use that place. I mean 'that place'.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，接下来我得和他们长谈一番，就拜托你了。你到了那边，别忘了用那个地方。我是说“那个地方”。

scripts.text: Pardon? I see.. See you later.
Yikes! Wait a minute! I almost forgot. This is the reward specially prepared for this mission. I am giving all of them to you. You can exchange this with something useful.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！等一下！我差点忘了。这是专门为这次任务准备的奖励。我把它们都给你。你可以用它们交换有用的东西。

scripts.text: Seems like the dull middle-aged person standing beside the stairs receives the tokens. His name is Strasse. If you are interested, go.
scripts.translation: 楼梯旁站着个沉闷的中年人，负责兑换代币。他叫斯特拉瑟。感兴趣的话就去找他吧。

scripts.text: I gave you everything. Bye now. Say hello to the President!!
scripts.translation: 我都给你了。再见。替我向会长问好！！

scripts.text: Yo! Welcome! Do you want a cup of tea? Did you send the message properly?
scripts.translation: 哟！欢迎！你想喝杯茶吗？你好好把消息送出去了吗？

scripts.text: Tell the guard that Rookie sent you.
scripts.translation: 告诉卫兵是新人派你来的

scripts.text: Although he sent you here, you cannot enter.
scripts.translation: 然是他派你来的，但你不能进入。

scripts.text: Why is it so noisy here?
How many times do you think I told you to be quiet!
scripts.translation: ！我告诉过你多少次要保持安静！

scripts.text: This person wants to go inside, claiming that Rookie sent him/her.
scripts.translation: ..这个人说是新人派他来的，想进去。

scripts.text: The kid sent you. So, what about it?
scripts.translation: 是那个小孩派你来的。所以，那又怎样？

scripts.text: You...... You're the one who made a fuss downstairs a moment ago.
scripts.translation: 你...你就是刚才在楼下闹事的人。

scripts.text: I have no idea what brought you here. But I can't let you in.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你来这里做什么，但不能放你进去。

scripts.text: Do not make a fuss. Go back!
You cannot change anything by asking me for a favor.
If it hadn't been for the order of our leader, I could just knock you out right here......
scripts.translation: 要不是首领有令，我刚才就把你打晕在这里了...

scripts.text: You will be in trouble, if you keep making a fuss.
scripts.translation: 开。再闹下去，你会有麻烦的。

scripts.text: The exit is downstairs. Go there.
Do you want to die right now?
This is the voice I've never heard before. Is it the adventurer who helped that kid?
scripts.translation: ！这声音我从没听过。是帮助过那个孩子的冒险者吗？

scripts.text: We cannot leave our savior outside. Let the adventurer come in.
scripts.translation: 。不能让我们的救命恩人一直待在门外。让冒险者进

scripts.text: Let me give him/her a cup of tea.
If you behave rudely, you won't go back alive.
scripts.translation: 你要是敢无礼，就别想活着回去。

scripts.text: - The door seems to be locked -
- You hear the conversation from inside the room. -
scripts.translation: - 你听见房间里有人在交谈。 -

scripts.text: ... So I was thinking that you were having dementia.
scripts.translation: ...我还以为你得了老年痴呆呢。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, you should make yourself up!
scripts.translation: 说起来，你也该打扮打扮了！

scripts.text: This is why you look older!
scripts.translation: 这就是你看起来显老的原因！

scripts.text: Sometimes you look older than Cotnes!
scripts.translation: 有时候你看起来比科特内斯还老！

scripts.text: It seems like you have more wrinkles these days.
scripts.translation: 你最近皱纹好像变多了。

scripts.text: Why don't you put on some anti-wrinkle cream?
This all is because of the air here!
scripts.translation: 这都是这里的空气造成的！

scripts.text: This type of air is critical to the dry skin like yours!
scripts.translation: ！这种空气最伤你这种干性皮肤了！

scripts.text: Come to think of it, remember that kid who came here before?
scripts.translation: 说起来，还记得之前来过的那个孩子吗？让

scripts.text: Tell him to buy some cosmetics from Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation: 他去卢恩·米德加兹买些化妆品回来！

scripts.text: I have heard there's a fascinating cosmetic shop there.
scripts.translation: 我听说那边有家很棒的化妆品店。

scripts.text: It's difficult for our kids to go all the way there to buy cosmetics.
scripts.translation: 让孩子们跑那么远去买化妆品也不容易。

scripts.text: There is a problem with the position as well...
That kid? Who are you talking about?
The kid from the Secret Wings~
scripts.translation: 就是那个秘密之翼来的孩子~

scripts.text: I remember I asked him for an errand. Will he be back here?
scripts.translation: ！我记得我让他帮我办过一件事。他会回来吗？

scripts.text: It's like you solved the whole problem. And they won't get past you.
scripts.translation: 这就像是你一下子解决了所有问题，他们也别想从你这里溜过去。

scripts.text: Of course, we have some important thoughts~
scripts.translation: 当然，我们也有重要的想法~

scripts.text: You're so great. How can you think of such an idea in that short moment?
scripts.translation: 你真厉害。怎么能在那么短的时间内想到这种主意？

scripts.text: Not to mention the president, Heart Hunters are irritating to us as well.
scripts.translation: 不只是总裁，心之猎手也让我们很头疼。

scripts.text: Although they are all novices, they can be an obstacle for us in defeating the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation: 虽然他们都是些新手，但我们要是去对付秘密之翼，他们也可能趁机坏事。

scripts.text: Let's say we attack the Secret Wings recklessly and Heart Hunters takes the chance to attack us. We'll collapse in a minute.
scripts.translation: 假如我们贸然攻击秘密之翼，心之猎手又趁机反咬一口，我们很快就会全盘崩溃。

scripts.text: So we will pretend to cooperate with the Secret Wings and get rid of the annoying ones first.
scripts.translation: 所以我们先假装和秘密之翼合作，优先除掉那些碍事的家伙。

scripts.text: Let's finish them before they realize we have a plan to attack them.
scripts.translation: 趁他们还没察觉我们的计划，先把他们解决掉。

scripts.text: We're Rebellions. And we are at the end of guns.
scripts.translation: 我们可是反叛者，早已身处枪口之下。

scripts.text: Let me finish my karma in my generation.
scripts.translation: 就让我在这一代了结这段恩怨吧

scripts.text: I don't want to leave it to youngsters.
This is good to have this opportunity before I die.
scripts.translation: 能在死前得到这样的机会，真是太好了。

scripts.text: I saw Rupert crying after you said that.
scripts.translation: 我刚才看到鲁伯特听到你这么说后哭了。

scripts.text: He's not cute anymore, he is just a middle-aged man. But to him, you're like mother.
scripts.translation: 他已经不可爱了，只是个中年大叔。但在他眼里，你就像母亲一样。

scripts.text: What we have now is a pleasant party. I'm looking forward to it.
scripts.translation: 我们现在终于能办一场热闹的聚会了，我很期待。哈

scripts.text: Then I'll fix the party accessories in advance.
scripts.translation: 那我就提前准备好聚会的装饰品吧。呵

scripts.text: Take a seat and have some cookies.
It's dangerous to be excited at our age...
scripts.translation: 。我们这个年纪，太激动可不太好...

scripts.text: We have been talking about the party that will be held soon.
scripts.translation: 迎。我们刚才正在讨论即将举行的聚会。

scripts.text: It's been a long time since an outsider came in here for the last time.
scripts.translation: 上次有外人进来，已经是很久以前的事了。

scripts.text: If you do not want me to make a nice hole in your head, leave now.
scripts.translation: 你要是不想让我在你脑袋上开个漂亮的洞，就赶紧离开。

scripts.text: I talked it out with my sister.
Don't just be standing there. Sit down here.
Let me persuade the people who are against this.
scripts.translation: 让我去说服那些反对的人。

scripts.text: What the hell are you saying!
That's the request from the president!
scripts.translation: 那是总裁的要求！就是那

scripts.text: Well... If Dien agrees, I will agree, too.
scripts.translation: 嗯...如果迪恩同意，我也同意。

scripts.text: This is the request from those guys!
Dien must have some thoughts about it.
scripts.translation: 迪恩一定有自己的想法。

scripts.text: Although you are my sister, I will never accept this!
scripts.translation: 虽然你是我的姐姐，但我绝不会接受这件事！

scripts.text: If you stay here longer, you might get an air hole in your head.
scripts.translation: 出去。再待下去，我可能会在你脑袋上开个洞。

scripts.text: I know you've met Rupert. Have you met ^ff0000Erst^000000?
scripts.translation: 我知道你见过鲁伯特。你见过厄斯特吗？ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Larcis. Go with this adventurer and hand them this letter.
scripts.translation: 拉西斯。带着这位冒险者，把这封信交给他。

scripts.text: And tell the kids in front of the door not to enter here until Ridsh calms down.
scripts.translation: 还有，告诉门口的小孩，在里德什冷静下来之前不要进来。

scripts.text: Follow me. We are going to commander Erst first.
scripts.translation: 跟我来。我们要先去见指挥官厄斯特。

scripts.text: If you stay here longer, you might get an air hole in your head.
scripts.translation: 如果你再待在这里，我可能会在你头上打个空气洞。

scripts.text: I know you've met Rupert. Have you met Erst?
scripts.translation: 我知道你见过鲁伯特。你见过厄斯特吗？

scripts.text: Larcis. Go with this adventurer and hand them this letter.
scripts.translation: 拉西斯。带着这位冒险者，把这封信交给他。

scripts.text: And tell the kids in front of the door not to enter here until Ridsh calms down.
scripts.translation: 还有，告诉门口的小孩，在里德什冷静下来之前不要进来。

scripts.text: Follow me. We are going to commander Erst first.
scripts.translation: 跟我来。我们要先去见指挥官厄斯特。

scripts.text: I'm surprised that Erst accepted it so easily.
scripts.translation: 没想到厄斯特这么爽快地就答应了。

scripts.text: Without further delay, meet Rupert again.
scripts.translation: 事不宜迟，再去见见鲁伯特吧。

scripts.text: Since most of the kids are busy these days, I feel somewhat bored.
scripts.translation: 。最近孩子们都很忙，我觉得有点无聊。

scripts.text: By the way, what brought you here? I thought you finished your business.
scripts.translation: 话说回来，你这次来有什么事吗？我还以为你的事情都办完了呢。

scripts.text: I guess I answered your question...
scripts.translation: 看来我已经回答你的问题了...

scripts.text: You haven't forgotten about the errand?
I didn't really mean to ask you for a favor. It's so kind of you to remember it!
scripts.translation: 我其实没真想麻烦你。你还记得，真是太好了！

scripts.text: We were talking about the party we are planning soon.
scripts.translation: 我们刚才在商量近期要办的聚会。

scripts.text: It was nearly over. But several ingredients are missing.
scripts.translation: 本来差不多谈妥了，可还缺几样食材。

scripts.text: Since Larcis is in charge of our business, please ask him. He will tell you what we need.
scripts.translation: 拉西斯负责处理这些事，去问问他吧。他会告诉你需要什么。

scripts.text: Well...... I heard what they said about you.
Did you help the kid when he fell on the ground?
scripts.translation: 那个孩子摔倒时，是你帮了他吗？

scripts.text: You know, that tall guy who doesn't talk much.
scripts.translation: 就是那个很高、不太爱说话的人。

scripts.text: He bought some expensive cookies for us on his way to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: 他去里希塔乐镇的路上，给我们买了一些很贵的饼干。

scripts.text: It was so delicious and we finished it that day. Didn't we?
scripts.translation: 那饼干太好吃了，我们当天就吃完了，对吧

scripts.text: It would have been better if we saved it for visitors.
scripts.translation: 吗？要是留一点给客人就好了。

scripts.text: If you save it, there will be mold on it.
By the way, what happened to Gonie that time?
scripts.translation: 话说回来，那次戈尼后来怎么样了？

scripts.text: I was lucky to find him early.
I heard what they were saying.
scripts.translation: 我听到他们在说什么了

scripts.text: It sounds like he has been cured and is all right now.
scripts.translation: 。听起来他已经被治愈了，现在没事了。
孩子们都在拼命努力呢...

scripts.text: I hope they don't get hurt.
Every time they leave the base, I'm afraid they might get hurt.
scripts.translation: 。每次他们离开基地，我都担心会出意外。

scripts.text: They are adults, not babies. They can take care of themselves.
scripts.translation: 他们都已经是大人了，不是小宝宝，会照顾好自己的。

scripts.text: By the way, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 顺便问一下，你在这里做什么？

scripts.text: I don't think you came here for tea and chatting with us.
scripts.translation: 我觉得你来这里不是为了喝茶和聊天的。

scripts.text: Where do you think you are? That's sheer nonsense!
scripts.translation: 你以为你在哪里？这简直是胡说八道！

scripts.text: How can I calm down on hearing that?
scripts.translation: 听到那种话我怎么能冷静？

scripts.text: No wonder they started talking about Gonie. It seemed like they were hiding something from the beginning!
scripts.translation: 难怪他们开始谈论戈尼。看起来他们从一开始就在隐瞒什么！

scripts.text: If you do not want me to make a nice hole in your head, leave now.
scripts.translation: 如果你不想让我在你头上打个漂亮的洞，现在就离开。

scripts.text: Before we kill you all, there's no chance in hell we can ever cooperate with you!
scripts.translation: 除非我们把你们全杀光，否则绝不可能和你们合作！

scripts.text: You expected this before you came here, right?
scripts.translation: 你来之前就预料到会是这种局面了，对吧？

scripts.text: But we like your courage. So we will listen to you first.
scripts.translation: 不过我们欣赏你的勇气，所以愿意先听你说。

scripts.text: You must have been ready to die by the time you came here. So I will say this is the price of your life.
scripts.translation: 你来这里时，想必已经做好赴死的准备了。那就把这当作你求得活命的代价吧。

scripts.text: Whatever it is, it is none of our business!
Why do we have to help you?
You are the ones who abandoned us in suffering!
scripts.translation: 是你们抛弃了我们在苦难中挣扎！

scripts.text: I don't care what happens to their royal family!
scripts.translation: 兹？我才不在乎他们的皇室发生什么事！

scripts.text: The biggest wish of my life is the collapse of Schwartz!
scripts.translation: 尔特？我这辈子最大的心愿，就是看着施瓦茨瓦尔特垮台！

scripts.text: You can't handle Heart Hunter kids and ask us for help!
scripts.translation: 你们连心之猎手那群新人都对付不了，还来求我们帮忙！

scripts.text: Where is the arrogance you showed us when you abandoned us?
scripts.translation: 当初抛弃我们时的傲慢劲儿呢？

scripts.text: Can you give us some time to think about it?
scripts.translation: 能给我们一些时间考虑吗？这不是

scripts.text: - You have too many items in your inventory.
Please arrange your inventory and try again. -
She has never told me anything about party!
scripts.translation: 她从没跟我提过派对的事！

scripts.text: Oh! I remember she told me to bring something suspicious.
scripts.translation: 哦！我想起来了，她让我带点可疑的东西过来。

scripts.text: High Class Tea for Dien, Old Letter for Ridsh and Very Shining Ring for Cotnes.
scripts.translation: 给迪恩的上等茶叶、给里德什的旧信，还有给科特内斯的闪亮戒指。

scripts.text: At first sight, they don't look strange. But their locations are quite suspicious... They are in the northeastern corner of Einbroch. I have no idea how we can get them in such a place...
scripts.translation: 乍一看没什么特别，可它们的位置实在可疑...都在艾音布罗克东北角。我真想不通，怎么会跑到那种地方去...

scripts.text: But... they told us to bring them. So we have to go and get them.
scripts.translation: 不过...既然她们让我们去拿，就只能照办。

scripts.text: If you're willing to go, tell me!
scripts.translation: 如果你愿意去的话，告诉我！

scripts.text: Of course, we will compensate you.
scripts.translation: 当然，我们会给你报酬的。

scripts.text: Then would you please have a look at the tasks given by Dien, Ridsh and Cotnes?
scripts.translation: 那么请看一下迪恩、里德什和科特内斯交给你的任务吧？

scripts.text: Well.. I do not force you.
If you meet Julian in the northeastern corner of the northern field in Einbroch, he will let you in.
scripts.translation: 你找的东西。去艾音布罗克北部原野的东北角找朱利安，他会放你进去。

scripts.text: I don't know what's going on. But since it's order of {0}, we have to do it.
scripts.translation: 我也不清楚缘由，不过既然是{0}下的命令，我们就得照办。

scripts.text: A request you are currently doing.
A request you have already completed.
This is the High Class Tea Dien told me about... But why was it located in such a place?
scripts.translation: 这就是迪恩说的上等茶叶...不过为什么会放在那种地方？.

scripts.text: ... Anyway, you did a great job.
If you bring this token to Strasse at the stairs at 10 o'clock in the corridor of the 2nd floor, you will receive something useful in return.
scripts.translation: 把这个代币交给二楼走廊十点钟方向楼梯旁的斯特拉瑟，他会给你有用的东西。

scripts.text: This is the Old Letter Ridsh talked about... By the way, why does she need this letter...?

scripts.text: You are not only faithful, but diligent as well!

scripts.translation: 太好了！准备都完成了，你也来了。我来说明一下接下来的行动。

scripts.text: Teleporting is not available in the Schwaltzvalt area. I'm sure you know that.

scripts.text: Good. Actually, you don't need to know that.

scripts.text: I like your honesty. You don't actually need to know that.
scripts.translation: 我喜欢你的坦率。其实你不知道也没关系

scripts.text: According to the government of Schwaltzvalt, the use of teleport in the village is prohibited to prevent the overuse of magic. But it's just nonsense.
scripts.translation: 施瓦茨瓦尔特政府声称，为了避免过度使用魔法，禁止在村庄里使用瞬间移动。不过这都是胡扯。

scripts.text: There was an incident called 'Magic overuse'. Due to this incident, they passed the law to prohibit teleporting. In my opinion, 'Magic overuse' was manipulated by the government of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation: 曾经发生过一起所谓的“魔法滥用事件”，之后他们就通过法律禁止瞬间移动。在我看来，这起事件是施瓦茨瓦尔特政府一手操纵的。

scripts.text: We think the Schwaltzvalt government installed the equipment to limit teleporting to protect the secret research of the Rekenber enterprise.
scripts.translation: 我们认为，施瓦茨瓦尔特政府安装了限制瞬间移动的设备，是为了掩护雷根贝勒企业的秘密研究。

scripts.text: Looking at the series of incidents that happened after the equipment was installed, our conviction has become stronger.
scripts.translation: 设备安装后发生的一连串事件，更加坚定了我们的判断。

scripts.text: Haven't you heard of the mysterious disappearance in the slum?
scripts.translation: 你没听说过贫民窟的神秘失踪案吗？

scripts.text: Since it's an incident that has already happened and it is not important now, I will skip the explanation. If you are curious about it, you can search it later on.
scripts.translation: 那件事已经过去了，现在也不重要，我就不细说了。你要是好奇，以后可以自己调查。

scripts.text: In any case, we will destroy all the 'Teleport prohibition equipment' installed in Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation: 总之，我们要摧毁施瓦茨瓦尔特设置的所有“瞬间移动禁止设备”。

scripts.text: You deserve to be a hot person.

scripts.text: Hahahaha. But you don't have to worry.
At least, I know the location of one part of the equipment.
scripts.translation: 少我知道其中一处设备的位置。你
