scripts.text: Anyway, our agent in Einbech reported that a suspicious device showed up at the end of a freight train and disappeared quickly. The problem is..
scripts.translation: 总之，艾音贝赫的线人报告说，货运列车尾部曾出现一个可疑装置，很快又消失了。问题是...

scripts.text: There is no way to reveal the hidden and protected device for us to destroy..
scripts.translation: 我们没办法让那个被隐藏和保护的装置现形，也就无法摧毁它...

scripts.text: In this case, we can revise the incident step by step from the beginning, right?
scripts.translation: 既然如此，我们可以从头开始，一步步还原当时的情况。

scripts.text: Maybe we can find something we missed.
scripts.translation: 说不定能找到遗漏的线索。

scripts.text: It's been a long time since I used my head for the last time. Let's take a break to clear our minds.
scripts.translation: 我好久没动脑筋了。先休息一下，理理思路吧。

scripts.text: Great! It's high time to use my head, after a long while.
scripts.translation: 太好了！好久没动脑筋，是时候活

scripts.text: I will tell you the situation step by step from the moment when the agent found an unusual device. Once you find anything abnormal, tell me.
scripts.translation: 动一下了。我从线人发现异常装置时开始讲起。发现任何不对劲的地方就告诉我。

scripts.text: One day, our agent H in Einbech came out of the guardroom for the usual night patrol with a torch and club in each hand. H was wearing guard clothes.
scripts.translation: 有一天，我们在艾音贝赫的线人H像往常一样夜巡，左右手分别拿着火把和棍棒，从警卫室走了出来。H穿着卫兵制服。

scripts.text: H finished the patrol following the usual order. Finally, H went to the end of the freight train where he found an abnormal device.
scripts.translation: H按惯常路线完成巡逻。最后，他来到货运列车尾部，在那里发现了异常装置。

scripts.text: Normally, there is a strong wind every now and then. But, on that day, the wind was strong enough to turn off the light. Then..
scripts.translation: 平时这里偶尔会刮大风。那天风大到把火把吹灭了。就在那时...H说

scripts.text: H said that a suspicious device appeared for a moment and disappeared quickly.
scripts.translation: 他看到一个可疑装置突然出现，随即又消失了。

scripts.text: The only information we have is the statement by the agent.. After listening to this story, did you find anything unusual?
scripts.translation: 我们只有线人的这份证词...听完后，你发现哪里不对劲了吗？

scripts.text: He was wearing neat guard clothes cleaned and ironed by his daughter. But it's not unusual to wear neat guard clothes
scripts.translation: 他说制服是女儿洗好熨好的，很整洁。不过穿着整洁的卫兵制服本身没什么奇怪。

scripts.text: H says he carries a club every time he patrols, to prepare for some unexpected situations. This is not unusual either.
scripts.translation: H说他每次巡逻都会带棍棒，以防突发状况。这也不奇怪。

scripts.text: H patrols through the same course every day. He says it's written in the guard manual. I find nothing strange about it. Do you?
scripts.translation: H每天都走同一条巡逻路线，说是卫兵手册规定的。我觉得没什么奇怪。你觉得呢？

scripts.text: It was a train that carried coal from the mine. Since it was night, the train stopped. Well, they say the train is not operated a lot these days due to a great deal of monsters in the mine.
scripts.translation: 那是从矿坑运煤的列车。因为当时是夜里，列车停着没动。听说矿坑里魔物很多，最近列车也很少运行。

scripts.text: Since it is a mountainous area, there is occasionally a strong wind, even in normal times.. It happens every day, so I don't find it strange.
scripts.translation: 这里是山区，平时偶尔就会刮大风。这种事每天都会发生，我不觉得奇怪。

scripts.text: A strong wind.. The turned-off torch..
Oh?! I think I have found it.
Hahahahaha. You are a genius. Thanks to your support, the puzzle is solved. Now we have a reliable theory and let's test it.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈，你真是天才！多亏你的提示，谜题解开了。现在我们有了可靠的推测，来验证一下吧。

scripts.text: What kind of theory is it?
Hmm? You haven't noticed yet? I thought you noticed it already and then gave me a hint.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你还没发现吗？我以为你已经看出来了，才给我提示的。

scripts.text: The Turned-off torch.. Fire!! Yes, it's the fire. Since Einbech is a mountainous area, there is occasionally a strong wind there, even in normal times. What was different from usual was that the torch was turned off.
scripts.translation: 熄灭的火把...火！没错，关键就是火。艾音贝赫地处山区，平时偶尔也会刮大风。真正反常的是火把熄灭了。

scripts.text: Normally they say the fire is the strongest right before being turned off. So my theory focused on the fact that the device appeared for a while and disappeared quickly right before the torch was gone.
scripts.translation: 据说火焰在熄灭前会变得最旺。所以我的推论是：装置出现了一瞬间，随即在火把熄灭前消失了。

scripts.text: The very moment when the fire is strong and disappears!! That is the condition for the device to appear.
scripts.translation: 火焰最旺、即将熄灭的那一刻！装置只有在这种情况下才会出现。

scripts.text: What do you think about my theory? Isn't it worth trying?
scripts.translation: 你觉得我的理论怎么样？值得一试吗？

scripts.text: You seem so excited and I really don't get what you are saying. But if you are so positive about it, let's try. Trying won't hurt. Would it?
scripts.translation: 你看起来兴奋极了，我完全没听懂你在说什么。不过既然你这么有把握，那就试试看吧，反正试试也没坏处，对吧？

scripts.text: Since you are a hot person, your answer is also hot. Great! Let's go and try it. It's in this village anyway.
scripts.translation: 你果然够热血，回答也这么爽快。太好了！我们去试试吧，反正就在村子里。

scripts.text: You come to the very end of the freight train with the items with full of fire attributes.
scripts.translation: 带上火属性物品，去货运列车的尽头找我。

scripts.text: See you at the end of the freight train.
scripts.translation: 我们在货运列车的尽头见。

scripts.text: You were awesome. You deserve to be the hottest fellow in Clana Nemieri these days.
scripts.translation: 干得漂亮！你不愧是如今克拉纳·内米埃里最酷的人。

scripts.text: Hey look! My elder sister is so glad to hear that the equipment was destroyed.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你看！我姐姐听到装备被销毁的消息，高兴坏了。

scripts.text: His elder sister was just fishing around books and documents that she was looking at. But Arivero didn't seem to care about it and continued to speak in excitement.
scripts.translation: 他的姐姐仍在翻阅书籍和文件。阿里维罗似乎没注意到，依旧兴奋地说个不停。

scripts.text: Since we revealed the secret of teleport prohibition equipment, our agent in Lighthalzen was able to spot the location and attributes of the equipment.

scripts.text: The location is inside the mansion. The attribute is water. This information is too simple. Can we find it with this?

What kind of relationship is there between its installed location and the attribute of teleport prohibition device?

scripts.text: It gives me a headache. Let me think about it later.
scripts.translation: 真让人头疼，之后再想吧。我们

scripts.text: Is Wind strong against Water? Hey pal. What is the attribute stone for wind attribute? Do you know?
scripts.translation: 风属性克制水属性吗？嘿，朋友，风属性原石叫什么来着？你知道吗？

scripts.translation: 不是火灵原石。那是火属性原石，用来显现艾音贝赫的装置。

scripts.text: And Mystic Frozen is a water attribute stone required to reveal the device in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: 而水灵原石是水属性原石，用来显现里希塔乐镇的装置。

scripts.translation: 没错！风灵原石！这就是风属性原石。

scripts.translation: 土灵原石？那是地属性的吧，现在应该用不上。

scripts.text: Great! Bring me one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds.
scripts.translation: 太好了！带一块水灵原石和三块风灵原石来。我

scripts.translation: 真奇怪。你为什么这么着急？有

scripts.translation: 哦，我看起来那么着急吗？我们已经掌握了情报，我想赶在他们察觉前尽快摧毁设备。

scripts.text: As I told you, I used to be the hottest person in Clana Nemieri before you showed up!
scripts.translation: 正如我告诉你的，在你出现之前，我可是夜巡者转职考试地点最火热的人物！

scripts.text: Hey, let's get down to the business. Bring the materials and see you in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: ！说正事吧。带上材料，我们在里希塔乐镇碰面。

scripts.text: You were marvelous in Lighthalzen. No wonder you're such a hot person.
scripts.translation: 你在里希塔乐镇干得真漂亮！难怪你这么酷。快

scripts.translation: 看，我姐姐听说设备被毁，比刚才更高兴了！

scripts.text: Upon any consideration, I think Vero is misunderstanding something. The poker-faced lady he calls his sister is still fishing around books and documents. And why is he saying that she is pleased? Why does he say that?
scripts.translation: 不管怎么看，我都觉得维罗误会了什么。他那位面无表情的姐姐还在翻阅文件。他怎么会觉得她很高兴？

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you about this. Is she really pleased?
scripts.translation: 我想问问你这件事。她真的很高兴吗？

scripts.text: Look at her. She's not even looking here.
scripts.translation: 看看她。她甚至都没看这边。

scripts.text: What?! Can't you see her being pleased? Look at her now. She is pretending to ignore us, because she is shy. But the glow around her cheeks shows that she is pleased. Got it?
scripts.translation: 什么？你看不出她有多高兴吗？她现在只是假装不理我们，因为害羞了。你看她脸颊泛红，这不就说明她很开心吗？懂了吧？

scripts.text: Well, I don't get it. But I will just accept it, as her younger brother says so.
scripts.translation: 我还是不太明白。不过既然她弟弟这么说，我就姑且相信吧。

scripts.text: Hey! Friend!! There's something more important than it.
scripts.translation: 嘿，朋友！还有更要紧的事。

scripts.text: We have a problem. According to our schedule, we were planning to destroy the equipment in Yuno right after destroying the equipment in Lighthalzen..
scripts.translation: 我们遇到麻烦了。原定在里希塔乐镇摧毁设备后，马上就去破坏尤诺的设备...

scripts.text: Remember the device that prevented the prohibition equipment from disappearance?

You are dragging on.. You have something to ask me for, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你别绕弯子了...有事要我帮忙，对吧？

scripts.text: Hahaha. You figured it out? We are lucky to have all the materials to repair it, except for one core material. As usual, core materials are always a problem.
scripts.translation: 哈哈。你猜到了？我们运气不错，除了一个核心材料外，修复所需的材料都齐了。老样子，核心材料总是个问题。

scripts.text: So please bring one Star Crumb, the core material. Once you bring it to me, we can repair it and leave right away. I will be ready for it.
scripts.translation: 所以请带一颗星星的角来，那是修理所需的核心材料。拿来之后我们就能马上修好设备出发。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: All we have to do is to insert the Star Crumb. So once you bring it, we can leave right away.
scripts.translation: 只要把星星的角装进去就行。你一带来，我们就能马上

scripts.translation: 出发。地点和所需属性原石，我到时候再告诉你。我还没收集完情报，就拜托你了。

scripts.text: The basic repair is all over.
Now let me insert a Star Crumb, the core material..

们得尽早完成这次行动。

scripts.translation: 修理快完成了。哦，你把材料带来了！

scripts.text: Now let me insert a Star Crumb on the device. It's the end of repairing!!
scripts.translation: 现在我来把星星的角装进设备。修理终于要完成了！！

scripts.text: It's quite suspicious that Vero is not looking straight into my eyes. Maybe all he needed was the Star Crumb from the beginning. Shall I ask him about this?
scripts.translation: 维罗一直不敢直视我的眼睛，实在可疑。也许他从一开始就只想要星星的角。要不要问问他？

scripts.translation: 呼...算了，就当没看出来吧。说到底，公平交易嘛。

scripts.text: This is suspicious. Tell me honestly.
I won't be mad. All you needed was the Star Crumb from the beginning, right?
scripts.translation: 我不会生气的。你从一开始就只需要星星的角，对吧？

scripts.text: No! What kind of jerk do you take me for? Just look into my eyes!
scripts.translation: 不！你以为我是那种人吗？看着我的眼睛！

scripts.text: It's very suspicious of him to be mad like it. But I decided to laugh it off.
scripts.translation: 他气成这样，反而更可疑了。不过我决定装作没发现。

scripts.text: Although there has been a minor incident, now we have two more prohibition equipment devices to destroy.
scripts.translation: 虽然出了点小状况，但还有两台禁制设备等着我们去破坏。

scripts.text: But since we found the location and attribute of the prohibition equipment installed in Yuno, we can leave right now.
scripts.translation: 不过，尤诺那台设备的位置和属性都查清楚了，现在就能出发。

scripts.translation: 4。它是风属性的。我们的特工会给我们一块风灵原石，到了那里就能摧毁设备。

scripts.text: Please get four Great Natures and come to Yuno. They have opposite attributes to the Wind attribute.
scripts.translation: 请准备四块地灵原石，然后到尤诺来。地属性正好克制风属性。

scripts.text: Ah! Sir, that's not what I am talking about.. You briefly reported to the Rebellion leader regarding what you did with Vero.
scripts.translation: 啊！先生，我不是那个意思...我刚才简短地向反叛者首领汇报了和维罗一起执行的任务。

scripts.text: Have you been doing such a great mission?
scripts.translation: 你竟然执行了这么重要的

scripts.text: But it's strange. I've never been reported that there's been such a mission lately.
scripts.translation: 任务？不过很奇怪，我最近没听说有这样的任务。

scripts.text: No mission? Then what happened to the mission I did?
scripts.translation: 没有任务？那我执行的任务是怎么回事？

scripts.text: I'm curious about it, too. I know you are exhausted after coming back from your mission. But please tell me about your mission in detail.
scripts.translation: 我也很好奇。知道你刚出任务回来很疲惫，不过还是请详细说说任务经过。

scripts.text: You told the Rebellion leader about what happened during your mission to eliminate Teleport prohibition equipment of Schwaltzvalt with Vero.
scripts.translation: 你向反叛者首领讲述了与维罗一起执行的任务，内容是摧毁施瓦茨瓦尔特（Schwaltzvalt）的禁止瞬间移动设备。

scripts.text: Arivero Yurhik.. As you said, that Gunslinger's surname seems to be same with that of Noa here.

scripts.text: But as far as I can remember, there is no Gunslinger named Arivero Yurhik in Clana Nemieri..

scripts.translation: 咦？！我不明白...虽然他突然在艾音布罗克消失了，但他确实一直和我一起执行任务...

scripts.text: Wait! Calm down and listen to me.
The young man named Arivero told you he's a younger brother of Noa. Right?
scripts.translation: 那个叫阿里维罗的年轻人告诉你，他是诺亚的弟弟，对吧？

scripts.text: I have a strong feeling that Arivero guy you met is Noa's brother, even if Noa's younger brother died in an accident when he was young.
scripts.translation: 我强烈觉得你遇到的阿里维罗就是诺亚的弟弟，尽管诺亚的弟弟小时候就因意外去世了。

scripts.text: Really?! Did you say he died..?
scripts.translation: 真的吗？！你说他已经去世了...？

scripts.text: In this world, there are so many things that we cannot identify.
scripts.translation: 这个世界上有很多事情，我们至今都无法解释。

scripts.text: I can't tell you any further, because it is Noa's personal information. Let's not talk about this anymore. By the way..
scripts.translation: 那是诺亚的私事，我不能再多说。我们别再谈这个了。对了...

scripts.text: You did a great job. Maybe, two of you?
scripts.translation: 你们做得很好。也许该说是

scripts.translation: 你们两位？你们摧毁了施瓦茨瓦尔特所有的禁制

scripts.text: Although the mission started unusually, it is surely a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation: 装置。任务虽然开始得很离奇，但成果确实了不起。

scripts.text: Since it was not an official mission, I cannot give you a huge reward. But it's still a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation: 由于这不是官方任务，我无法给你们丰厚的奖励。但这仍然是一项了不起的成就。

scripts.text: Let's say this is a small compensation for your great work.
scripts.translation: 就把这个当作对你们出色表现的一点谢礼吧。

scripts.text: The Rebellion leader disappeared like that.
scripts.translation: 反叛者首领就这样消失了。我

I will remember this as a mission with various questions remaining.
scripts.translation: 这趟任务留下了许多未解之谜，我会一直记得。

伙计，我们要把它摧毁吗？

scripts.text: We need an item that has a strong Water attribute.

scripts.translation: 水灵原石？它确实蕴含很强的水属性。没错，应该足以对付这台设备。不过一两块不够。

scripts.text: I think we need at least three of them.

scripts.translation: 水灵原石？它确实蕴含很强的水属性，足够对付这台设备。我们试试看吧。
太好了！我们摧毁了设备。

scripts.text: Although we destroyed the equipment, there is some magic power remaining. Therefore, teleporting will not be possible in this area for a while.
scripts.translation: 伙计。虽然设备摧毁了，但仍残留一些魔力，所以这片区域暂时无法使用瞬间移动。

scripts.translation: 禁制装置已经摧毁。现在回克拉纳·内米埃里吧。

We must destroy this before they realize that the equipment items are being destroyed one by one. Bring them quickly.

scripts.translation: 抱歉！抱歉！其实我早就到了。但我必须找特工确认准确的位置。我应该早点到并通知你的。抱歉让你一个人跑来这里。

scripts.translation: 重要的是我们都安全地到了这里。记得我让你带一个水灵原石和三个风灵原石吧？

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen. The location is clear, because I checked it with our agent. If we break the Mystic Frozen you brought into pieces..
scripts.translation: 水灵原石。位置很明确，因为我通过特工确认过了。如果我们把你带来的水灵原石打碎...

scripts.text: Good! The equipment has showed up..
And we installed the device we brought..
scripts.translation: 们带来的固定装置也安好了...

scripts.text: Great. Now we can destroy it. Prepare the Rough Wind.
scripts.translation: 太好了。现在我们可以摧毁它了。准备好风灵原石。

scripts.text: Nevertheless, the first one is always tough and it is easier from the second one. Now let us disappear with teleporting..
scripts.translation: 不过，第一台总是最难的，之后就容易多了。现在用瞬间移动撤离吧...

scripts.text: We cannot teleport immediately after destroying it. I told you about it and I forgot it myself! What a shame.
scripts.translation: 。摧毁后不能立刻使用瞬间移动。我告诉过你的，结果我自己都忘了！真丢人。

scripts.text: Ha! In the past, due to the magic power of this prohibition equipment.. Oh! It's nothing.
scripts.translation: 哈！之前都是因为这台禁制装置的魔力...哦，没什么。总之，我们

scripts.text: To avoid getting caught, let's scatter.
scripts.translation: 为了不被发现，我们分头行动吧。

scripts.text: Is this it? The mansion surrounded by water? According to the condition, it seems like it.
scripts.translation: 这是那座宅邸吗？四面都被水环绕...看来符合条件。

scripts.text: Oops?! My hot friend has already arrived.
scripts.translation: 哎呀？！我最酷的朋友已经到了。

scripts.text: Welcome, pal! I have just arrived now. I summoned the equipment and mounted it to prevent from disappearing.
scripts.translation: 欢迎，伙计！我刚到这里，已经把固定装置架好了，免得设备消失。

scripts.text: Not yet. I will be guarding this here. Please bring it quickly.
scripts.translation: 还没带来吗？我会在这里看守，请尽快拿来

scripts.translation: 。特工说雷肯贝尔和政府都认真起来了。

scripts.text: You are a reliable friend of mine.
scripts.translation: 你可是我信得过的朋友

scripts.translation: 。时间不多了，我们赶紧摧毁设备，再去艾音布罗克。特工说雷肯贝尔和政府已经开始认真应对了。

scripts.text: I will destroy the equipment right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在就摧毁装备。准备

scripts.translation: 禁制装置已经摧毁，而且似乎没有目击者。保险起见，我们分头前往艾音布罗克吧。

scripts.text: Oh! I haven't told you the location.
It is the place where Einbroch Wind turbine is located. You bring three Flame Hearts and one remaining Great Nature. We will use them to destroy the equipment.
scripts.translation: 就在艾音布罗克的风车那里。你带三块火灵原石和一块剩下的土灵原石过来。我们要用它们来摧毁设备。

scripts.text: Vero disappeared in a hurry, as if he was being chased by something. Take three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature and go to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 维罗匆忙消失了，好像被什么东西追赶着。带上三块火灵原石和一块土灵原石，去艾音布罗克。

scripts.text: have you brought three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature?
scripts.translation: 你带三块火灵原石和一块土灵原石了吗？
